3000.name: Traveler's Cloak
3000.lore: It's not fancy but it makes going from here to there a far more pleasant experience. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

3001.name: Leather Armor
3001.lore: Is it the prettiest thing in the world? No. Is it better than a knife in your belly? Without question. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

3002.name: Short Sword
3002.lore: Not every hero wields a blade... but let's be honest, most of them do. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

3003.name: Healing Salve
3003.lore: A soothing balm that eases the most grievous of wounds. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

3004.name: Fountain Flask
3004.lore: This water blessed by the Ancients can cure any wound. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

3005.name: Potion of Knowledge
3005.lore: They say a little bit of knowledge can be a dangerous thing... it also can be your salvation... — Jolixia, The Card Faun

3006.name: Town Portal Scroll
3006.text_plain: Return an allied hero to the Fountain.
3006.lore: Knowing when to step away from a battle isn't cowardice, it is wisdom. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

4000.name: Farvhan the Dreamer
4000.text_plain:
Pack Leadership
Farvhan the Dreamer's allied neighbors have +1 Armor.
4000.lore: Magnus brought the child to us for safe keeping. He didn't say why but he didn't have to. I knew who she was, and who she could become. — Farvhan, the Prowler Shaman

4001.name: Pack Leadership
4001.text_plain: Farvhan the Dreamer's allied neighbors have +1 Armor.

4002.name: Prowler Vanguard
4002.text_plain: Prowler Vanguard's allied neighbors have +1 Armor.
4002.lore: I don't know why the child is important... all I know is that we have been charged with her protection, and we won't let The Shaman down. — The Prowler Vanguard take in Ilexa

4003.name: Keefe the Bold
4003.lore: Fighting is like crushing someone's skull with a tree trunk. That's an analogy! — Keefe Treekiller, the Ogre Bruiser

4004.name: Fighting Instinct
4004.text_plain: Modify a red hero with +1 Attack and +1 Armor.
4004.lore: Life is a series of people trying to kill you. Kill them first. — Keefe imparts wisdom to his 4 year old daughter

4005.name: Debbi the Cunning
4005.text: [abilityname[Meticulous Planner]]{s:thisCardName} deals +2 damage when attacking a [g:0[hero]] or [g:2[tower]].
4005.text_plain:
Meticulous Planner
Debbi the Cunning deals +2 damage when attacking a hero or tower.
4005.lore: Kobold's aren't born with names. We take them from the first person we kill. In retrospect I should have considered that before I shoved that baker into her oven. On the other hand - I kind of look like a Debbi. — Debbi, the Kobold Saboteur

4006.name: Meticulous Planner
4006.text: {s:parentCardName} deals +2 damage when attacking a [g:0[hero]] or [g:2[tower]].
4006.text_plain: Debbi the Cunning deals +2 damage when attacking a hero or tower.

4007.name: No Accident
4007.lore: Ever since I heard about the Jasper Circle I wanted to be a part of it, but a group like that... you don't ask to join, you have to be approached... which means you need to make a name for yourself. Six months I shadowed Sunbreeze. Six months of watching that stupid fairy do stupid merchant fairy things. Finally I had a plan. Then the Veiled Sisterhood went and assassinated Kwerthias which ruined everything. Sure I could have killed Sunbreeze, but then people would have given the Sisterhood the credit, so I just said to hell with it and scrapped everything. — Debbi, Foiled Assassin

4008.name: J'Muy the Wise
4008.text_plain:
Wisdom of the Elders
Active 4: Draw a card.
4008.lore: The people I lead are small in number but vast in potential... and I will not see them slaughtered as the forest burns. The time has come for us to leave our ancestral home; and so I will lead my tribe to Weeping Rose... there our magicks will be celebrated, not feared. — The Dark Troll Chieftain on his people's exodus

4010.text: Choose a [g:607[unit]]. Choose a combat target for it.
4010.text_plain: Choose a unit. Choose a combat target for it.
4010.lore: Sometimes the simplest of spells can be the most effective. — J'muy, The Dark Troll Chieftain

10001.name: Venomancer
10001.text: [abilityname[Venomous Nature]][g:409[Summon]] a [[Plague Ward]] into {s:thisCardName}'s lane each [g:204[deployment phase]].
10001.text_plain:
Venomous Nature
Summon a Plague Ward into Venomancer's lane each deployment phase.
10001.lore: Most people are content eeking out an existence... eat. Work. Copulate. Sleep. This cycle continues, ad nauseam yielding useless children that are raised by their useless parents to have useless purposes in life. But I am not most people. I am a man of vision. My daughters are creations of purpose. And together we will spread a delicious poison across this countryside, purging it of weakness and stupidity. — Lesale, the Venomancer

10002.name: Sow Venom
10002.lore: I like to take time when placing my creations, ensuring that each of my daughters has a chance to blossom into what they are destined to become...but sometimes I'm seized with inspiration and tend to my work faster than normal. — Venomancer, Wicked Gardener

10003.name: Plague Ward
10003.text: [g:200[Before the action phase]], deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to a random [g:600[enemy neighbor]] of {s:thisCardName}.
10003.text_plain: Before the action phase, deal 2 piercing damage to a random enemy neighbor of Plague Ward.
10003.lore: My daughters are beautiful in design and purpose. To see them spread their poison is a wonder to behold. — Venomancer, Proud Papa
effects: [g:200[Before the action phase]], deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to a random [g:600[enemy neighbor]] of {s:thisCardName}.

10004.name: Meepo
10004.text:
[abilityname[Poof]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Move {s:thisCardName} to an allied [[Meepo]]'s lane. [g:608[□]] Deal 2 damage to the new [g:600[enemy neighbors]].]]

[abilityname[United We Fall]]{s:thisCardName} has [g:512[Soulbound]]. (If {s:thisCardName} dies, other allied {s:thisCardName}s in every lane also die.)
10004.text_plain:
Poof
Active 2: Move Meepo to an allied Meepo's lane. Deal 2 damage to the new enemy neighbors.

United We Fall
Meepo has Soulbound. (If Meepo dies, other allied Meepos in every lane also die.)
10004.lore: I'm not going to lie, life's been a little rough. I was on a tear playin' the couriers in White Spire, when all of a sudden I hit a cold streak. It happens. We figure we were due for a win so we go to Momma Eeb and take out a marker. Based on past dealings, Eeb's not too keen to let us borrow the money so we give her Meepo 3 as a collateral. We go back to the track, and well- look, I can't stress enough how cold the couriers were that day. We have a team meeting and decide it's not fair that Meepo 3 gets his legs broken because a sure thing fell through. So I go the Jasper Circle and get a loan to pay Eeb and get Meepo 3 back. But now we're in it with the Jasper Circle so we really don't want to take any chances because Momma Eeb will mess you up, Lasan will straight up kill ya. So we decide to do some odd jobs for the Ravenhooks and skim enough money off the top to be able to pay back the Jasper Circle, but that's when I realize that there's no way we could get cleaned out 3 times in a row... you're smart people, I think you can figure out where this is going. So mistakes were made and now we're back to where we started with the Jasper Circle debt only this time the Ravenhooks won't take us back because, ya know, we robbed them. We're freaking out and pointing fingers, and that's when Meepo 3 sees a wanted poster for our old friend Mireska. Now Lord Sunbreeze has put a huge bounty on his daughter that would cover the Jasper debt in spades, but A: Mireska's a friend... and more importantly B: there was no way we'd get to her before Gondar did. So I come up with a new plan. Gondar will capture Mireska. We'll free Mireska. Mireska will owe us. And Mireska will keep the Jasper Circle from killing us. It's a perfect plan. What could go wrong? — Meepo, Petty Con Man

10005.name: Divided We Stand
10005.lore: I think it's important to have friends that can compensate for your weakness. For instance, I'm great at playing cards; whereas Meepo 2 is more of a dice guy. Does that mean we all get along? Of course not, one of us is always getting the rest of us in trouble... but at the end of the day, we always work together to find a way out... because if you can't count on yourselves... who can you count on? — Meepo, Team of Grifters

10006.name: Luna
10006.text: [abilityname[Lucent Beam]][g:200[Before the action phase]], deal 1 [g:508[piercing]] damage to a random enemy and add a charge to three random [[Eclipse]] cards in your hand or deck.
10006.text_plain:
Lucent Beam
Before the action phase, deal 1 piercing damage to a random enemy and add a charge to three random Eclipse cards in your hand or deck.
10006.lore: Once I was like Sorla Khan... a warlord that did as she pleased. Strong and immortal I knew that no man or beast was my equal... until my hubris cost me everything. It was there at my lowest that Selemene found me. Tested me. And showed me the moon lit path. Much time has passed since that day, and I find purpose and pride in protecting the Nightsilver Woods with other members of the Dark Moon. But word has spread of Sorla Khan's march, and while we have never met I understand her all too well. And so I travel to Roseleaf to defeat her, and save her from herself. — Luna, the Moon Rider

10007.name: Eclipse
10007.text: Repeat one time for each charge: [g:608[□]] Deal 3 [g:508[piercing]] damage to a random enemy.
10007.text_plain: Repeat one time for each charge: Deal 3 piercing damage to a random enemy.
10007.lore: Selemene has rewarded my faith in her with terrible power, and I have taken a vow never to misuse it. — Luna, Servant of Selemene

10010.name: Winter Wyvern
10010.text: [abilityname[Arctic Burn]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Move {s:thisCardName} to an empty combat position and give it +4 [g:509[Attack]] this round.]]
10010.text_plain:
Arctic Burn
Active 2: Move Winter Wyvern to an empty combat position and give it +4 Attack this round.
10010.lore: Writers block. It is an awful condition that can ensure even the most prolific of authors. Once the words used to flow freely from my lips to my scribe Thrael's ears...but lately I have been... distracted by the pulp drivel Goodkind unleashes into the world. I had no idea that the adventures of a monosyllabic red thug could capture so many readers, yet if I am to be honest my own works feel boring in comparison... its vexing. Ah well, I guess it's time to find Goodkind and eat her. — Auroth, the Winter Wyvern

10011.name: Winter's Curse
10011.text: [g:404[Disarm]] a [g:607[unit]] until end of round. [g:608[□]] That [g:607[unit]]'s [g:601[allied neighbors]] [g:400[battle]] it.
10011.text_plain: Disarm a unit until end of round. That unit's allied neighbors battle it.
10011.lore: Feeble minds can prove useful for fleeting entertainment. — Winter Wyvern, Bored Poet

10014.name: Lycan
10014.text_plain:
Feral Impulse
Lycan's allied neighbors have +2 Attack.
10014.lore: My father was good man. A regent over the lands of Slom, he ruled the small folk with fairness and justice. My mother was the picture of patience and compassion, a woman beloved by her people as if they were her children. And my siblings? Gods we were trouble. I remember the day we found Father's collection of ancient maps, Tressa thought it would be funny if we- it doesn't matter now. They're all dead. — Banehallow, the Lycan

10016.name: Abaddon
10016.text: [abilityname[Borrowed Time]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Fully heal {s:thisCardName} and give it [g:507[Damage Immunity]] this round.]]
10016.text_plain:
Borrowed Time
Active 2: Fully heal Abaddon and give it Damage Immunity this round.
10016.lore: As a child I was baptized in the Font of Avernus...its black mist embracing me...enveloping me... becoming one with me. As a man I have wielded its power to defend the House of Avernus, and build a legacy that will never be forgotten. But rumors have reached my ears.... rumors that indicate that my familial font is not the only source of the mist... if this is true I must find it and consume it. For its blessings must remain mine alone. — Abaddon, the Lord of Avernus

10017.name: Chen
10017.text_plain:
Holy Persuasion
Active 4: Get control of an enemy creep.
10017.lore: The Rumusque Faithful have grown in number and in reputation and Lady Anshu is revered as a prophet and the second coming of Crella herself. Such a woman will be a powerful convert to the Knights of the Fold. And once I have shown her the true light of god... she will bring her followers to me. — Chen, Holy Knight of the Fold

10018.name: Bloodseeker
10018.text: [abilityname[Blood Bath]]Fully heal {s:thisCardName} after a [g:607[unit]] blocking it dies.
10018.text_plain:
Blood Bath
Fully heal Bloodseeker after a unit blocking it dies.
10018.lore: My homeland is a place of beauty and grace... of crystal streams and bountiful harvest...it is undeniably a gift from the gods. But when such a gift is bestowed upon you, it is right to give thanks... and there is only one way to show gratitude to the Flayed Twins. With blood. — Strygwyr, the Bloodseeker

10020.name: Axe
10020.lore: Axe is a man of many talents. Well one talent. The murder talent. However that seems to be enough for Axe to attract a legion of devoted fans that follow his adventures. It also probably helps that Axe's bard, Goodkind is good at what she calls 'embellishment'. Axe is unsure what the word means, but it's probably a good thing. — Axe, Adventurer and Murder Machine

10021.name: Centaur Warrunner
10021.lore: The hunt is a sacred thing, and to be asked to lead it is a great honor. These centaurs claim to be the finest hunters of the Marrowfell Tribe. We shall see if any of them are worthy to claim the Horn of the Alpha. — Bradwarden, the Centaur Warrunner

10022.name: Timbersaw
10022.text: [abilityname[Reactive Armor]]{s:thisCardName} has +1 [g:504[Armor]] for each of its attackers. {s:thisCardName}'s attackers have -1 [g:504[Armor]].
10022.text_plain:
Reactive Armor
Timbersaw has +1 Armor for each of its attackers. Timbersaw's attackers have -1 Armor.
10022.lore: I know they think I'm crazy... and that's ok... they didn't see what I saw... see what the trees did. 'Ohh it's nature, look at the beauty of the forest.' Lies. That's not a tranquil jungle... that's a sleeping army. And unless we are prepared when that forest starts to march it will be the end of everybody. — Rizzrack, the Timbersaw

10023.name: Bounty Hunter
10023.text: [abilityname[Jinada]][g:200[Before the action phase]], there is a 50% chance to give {s:thisCardName} +4 [g:509[Attack]] this round.
10023.text_plain:
Jinada
Before the action phase, there is a 50% chance to give Bounty Hunter +4 Attack this round.
10023.lore: Lord Sunbreeze is willing to pay handsomely to anyone who was able to return his daughter to him alive... which is somewhat unfortunate because 'Dead' is significantly easier for me. Oh well, the customer is always right. Looks like it's time to hunt a fairy. — Gondar, the Bounty Hunter

10024.name: Tidehunter
10024.text: [abilityname[Ravage]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■4:]] [g:405[Stun]] {s:thisCardName}'s [g:600[enemy neighbors]] this round and each other enemy has a 50% chance of being stunned this round.]]
10024.text_plain:
Ravage
Active 4: Stun Tidehunter's enemy neighbors this round and each other enemy has a 50% chance of being stunned this round.
10024.lore: My dominion over the seas is absolute... and soon it will be the same on land. — Leviathan, the Tidehunter

10025.name: Tinker
10025.text: [abilityname[Laser]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■3:]] Deal 3 damage to a [g:607[unit]] and [g:404[disarm]] it this round.]]
10025.text_plain:
Laser
Active 3: Deal 3 damage to a unit and disarm it this round.
10025.lore: The idea of working with Mazzie is...less exciting to me. But Sniper has raised some excellent points: The keen have been divided for too long and at least he doesn't yell at trees. Still, it's hard for me to overlook our past. Do I think we'll be friends? No. Do I think I can stomach his presence and not 'accidently' shoot in him the back of the head? Maybe if I drink enough. Time will tell. — Boush, the Tinker

10026.name: Rix
10026.text_plain:
Relentless Rebel
Rix has Rapid Deployment.
10026.lore: I was conscripted to the Bronze Legion when I was a pup. They marched through my village with their shiny armor and promises of glory and I couldn't sign on fast enough. I smiled when they put the conscript mark on my arm cause I knew that if I worked hard enough, if I followed orders, if I showed valor and skill in battle I would make something of myself and become more than just a stupid savage from redmaw. And so I followed. And fought. And killed. And with every town we occupied, every insurrection we quelled, every voice of dissent I silenced, the words 'for the glory of Stonehall' grew hollower, and that bronzed mark I took pride in became heavier. So now we march through Roseleaf to intercept the Red Mist Horde, and again my Commander has asked me to 'speak to my savage people'... well speak to them I shall... and when I do, they'll understand that I will fight beside them until every soldier is sent back to Stonehall in a bronzed coffin. — Rix, Leader of the Vhoul Rebellion

10028.name: Viper
10028.text: [abilityname[Corrosive Skin]]When a [g:607[unit]] deals [g:609[battle damage]] to {s:thisCardName}, [g:401[modify]] that [g:607[unit]] with -1 [g:509[Attack]].
10028.text_plain:
Corrosive Skin
When a unit deals battle damage to Viper, modify that unit with -1 Attack.
10028.lore: Once Pugna used me. Controlled me. Owned me. Eventually I escaped, and while at first I relished in my newfound freedom, as years passed it became a more hollow existence... for a while I thought this ennui came because my tormentor still roamed free, and I wouldn't find peace until I make him suffer as I did. But after I began my quest for vengeance I came to a realization. Pugna is not an abnormality. How many dabble in magic to summon and control. To create life then force it to obey. No. Pugna's enslavement won't bring me peace... but enslaving every wizard? Now that is something that will help me sleep well at night. — Viper, the Netherdrake

10029.name: Beastmaster
10029.text_plain:
Call of the Wild
Active 3: Summon a Loyal Beast.
10029.lore: Every year the Marrowfell Centaurs send their bravest warriors into Roseleaf to hunt Thunderhides... to them this gruesome safari is a rite of passage, but I will not let these majestic creatures be hunted for sport. The only question that remains is how many centaurs will I have to kill before they realize Roseleaf Forest is no longer their hunting grounds. — Karroch, the Beastmaster

10030.name: Bristleback
10030.text: [abilityname[Barroom Brawler]][g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with +2 [g:504[Armor]] after a [g:0[hero]] blocking it dies.
10030.text_plain:
Barroom Brawler
Modify Bristleback with +2 Armor after a hero blocking it dies.
10030.lore: I never went to some fancy military school to learn how to beat a man half to death... that's what bars were for. — Bristleback, Barfly

10031.name: Kanna
10031.text: [abilityname[Bringer of Conquest]]The random allied [[Melee Creeps]] are deployed into {s:thisCardName}'s lane.
10031.text_plain:
Bringer of Conquest
The random allied Melee Creeps are deployed into Kanna's lane.
10031.lore: I am a woman of my word. I promised my mother that I would find a way to fix my frail body, and I found salvation in the Dire. In exchange I promised the Dire a mighty army... and here you stand. And on the day we built this citadel I promised I would give you purpose... and you have found it in the glory of battle and the honor of serving The Dire. I am a woman of my word, and today I make a new promise: soon Prellex's body will be crushed in the rubble of her false god, and on that day you will be rewarded beyond all measure. — Kanna, Priestess of the Dire

10032.name: Drow Ranger
10032.text: [abilityname[Precision Aura]]Other allies in all lanes have +1 [g:509[Attack]].
10032.text_plain:
Precision Aura
Other allies in all lanes have +1 Attack.
10032.lore: Power is a funny thing. It's something we all want but are taught to be ashamed to seek. But power is neither good nor evil. It's freedom. It's the ability to live the life you choose, on the terms that you want. People like to criticize where that power came from but in time, history forgets... and only remembers what you chose to do with it. People can judge me for helping Kanna. But in time they will understand. — Traxex, the Drow Ranger

10033.name: Earthshaker
10033.text_plain:
Fissure
Active 4: Stun Earthshaker's enemy neighbors this round.
10033.lore: My existence shouldn't be. I was not born of a mother, but from a rock...and yet I was carved by no artisan. No... I willed my consciousness into being. For so long, I walked alone... confused... but that all changed when I met Kanna. I was rudderless, and she gave me direction. I was ignorant of the ways of man, and she gave me understanding. I was alone in this world, and she gave me companionship. But above all, she gave me a name and sense of self. Once I called myself Raigor Stonehoof...but she has given me a new name that is far more fitting...Earthshaker. — Earthshaker, Adopted Son

10036.name: Enchantress
10036.text_plain:
Nature's Attendants
Enchantress has +2 Regeneration. Enchantress's allied neighbors have +2 Regeneration.
10036.lore: Rix. Tresdin. Sorla Khan. You ask any one of them and they will spin you a story about why their cause is just; and every single one of them is wrong. This war is senseless, its cost will be immeasurable, and the only people who will profit are the future historians who'll sell books about the massacre. I can't stop this war from happening... but I will do whatever I can to minimize the damage. — Aiustha, the Enchantress

10038.name: Lich
10038.text: [abilityname[Sacrifice]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] [g:408[Condemn]] another ally and draw a card. If that ally has 6 or more [g:509[Attack]], draw an extra card.]]
10038.text_plain:
Sacrifice
Active 2: Condemn another ally and draw a card. If that ally has 6 or more Attack, draw an extra card.
10038.lore: Opportunity calls to me in Roseleaf. Lion flees to Weeping Rose, and will undoubtedly be looking for allies to aid him. The Vhoul are losing their battle against The Bronze Legion and are willing to do anything for victory... and the Crystal Maiden of Icewrack happens to be on holiday. It truly is an embarrassment of riches. The only lingering question is who should I kill first. — Ethreain, the Lich

10043.name: Ogre Magi
10043.text: [abilityname[Multicast]]After you play a [color:blue[blue [g:4[spell]]]], there is a 25% chance to put a base copy of that card into your hand.
10043.text_plain:
Multicast
After you play a blue spell, there is a 25% chance to put a base copy of that card into your hand.
10043.lore:
'It's not easy being the smartest ogre in the world. There's lots of jealous people out there.'
'Think about how many people you know with one head.'
'I bet it's a lot.'
'Now realize that every single one of them is half as smart as us. Do you know how lonely it is to walk this earth, never finding an intellectual eq-'
'WE LIKE ROCKS!'
'Yes...yes we do.' — Aggron Stonebreak, the Ogre Magi

10044.name: Omniknight
10044.lore: Something is stirring in Roseleaf. I'm not referring to Stonehall's war machine, or the Red Mist Horde... no... those are problems of flesh and blood, distractions keeping attention divided from the real danger. The Court of Ristul. But I cannot face this danger alone, and so I hope to meet with Luna of the Dark Moon. With the combined might of Selemene and the All Seeing One, we may have a chance. — Omniknight, Devoted to the Allseeing One

10046.name: Outworld Devourer
10046.text: [abilityname[Essence Aura]]After you play a [color:blue[blue card]], there is a 50% chance to restore 2 [g:511[Mana]].
10046.text_plain:
Essence Aura
After you play a blue card, there is a 50% chance to restore 2 Mana.
10046.lore: The Dire Child has begun to come into her own. She will need guidance. Molding. She has chosen the beast to be her champion... but I shall be her seneschal...and eventually... her master. — Harbinger, the Outworld Devourer

10047.name: Phantom Assassin
10047.text: [abilityname[Efficient Killer]]{s:thisCardName} deals +4 damage when attacking a [g:0[hero]].
10047.text_plain:
Efficient Killer
Phantom Assassin deals +4 damage when attacking a hero.
10047.lore: The Veiled Sisterhood gave me everything. My life. My skills. My family... My very purpose. So when the Veiled Oracles provide me a list of names, I never question what it is I need to do. — Mortred, the Phantom Assassin

10048.name: Pugna
10048.text_plain:
Nether Blast
Active 3: Condemn a random enemy improvement.
10048.lore: The Tyler Estate. It seeks to control magic. Punish those that violate rules set by the Quorum. But I will show them that some things cannot be controlled. And when the Tyler Estate Burns, I will set my sights on Weeping Rose itself. — Pugna, Ill-Tempered Nihilist

10050.name: Sniper
10050.text_plain:
Headshot
Active 3: Deal 5 damage to a unit.
10050.lore: For too long the Keenfolk have been fractured. Little colonies spread across the world each coveting their own research... but as we kept to our workshops the world around us changed. Stonehall rose to power. The nation of Revtel was born. The Quroum of Weeping Rose grew bolder... and what did we do? We toiled and tinkered. We built wondrous machines and used them for petty tasks. This cannot continue. The Keenfolk clans need to unite, and show the world what we're capable of. — Kardel, the Sniper

10052.name: Mazzie
10052.lore: So there I was: drinking with my friends, well actually I was drinking alone but I was thinking about my friends so it's basically the same thing. Anyway. Sniper walks into my workshop and is like 'Mazzie, you're wasting your life' and I'm like 'Geeze Sniper, if I wanted to feel bad about myself I'd ask my parents why they never visit me on my birthday' but Sniper's not interested in hearing about parental abandonment, he's interested in uniting the Keenfolk clans. So I say I'll help: on the condition that I get to give our group a cool name. Sniper rolled his eyes and sighed, which is basically the same thing as a yes, and THAT'S how the Society of Likeminded Keenfolk was born. — Mazzie, Founding Member of the Society of Likeminded Keenfolk

10053.name: Prellex
10053.text: [abilityname[Bringer of the Faithful]][g:409[Summon]] a [[Melee Creep]] into {s:thisCardName}'s lane each [g:204[deployment phase]].
10053.text_plain:
Bringer of the Faithful
Summon a Melee Creep into Prellex's lane each deployment phase.
10053.lore: Brothers and sisters, The Ancient is coming. With every passing day my visions grow stronger: A violet sky. A sundered moon. And an Ancient voice that whispers 'Prepare for my arrival.' Prepare. Such a simple word that does no justice to the work that lies before us... We must be heralds; walking testimonies to the benevolence of The Ancient. Spreading the word of its glorious arrival, no matter if that message is received with joy or scorn. We must be architects; building not just this monastery for those who believe what I have seen, but an entire world that is worthy of the Ancient's splendor. We must be zealots; willing to lay down our lives in defense of this sacred space, because rest assured we are at war. Kanna and her heretics will stop at nothing to undo the work that we've accomplished, and that is why we must return in kind. — Prellex, Priestess of the Radiant

10054.name: Sven
10054.text: [abilityname[Great Cleave]]{s:thisCardName} has +X [g:502[Cleave]] where X is equal to half its [g:509[Attack]].
10054.text_plain:
Great Cleave
Sven has +X Cleave where X is equal to half its Attack.
10054.lore: I've given myself to the Vigil Knights. I will train with them. Learn their ways. Become the best... and ultimately: destroy them from within. — Sven, Knight of the Vigil

10056.name: Treant Protector
10056.text_plain:
Branches of Iron
Treant Protector's allied neighbors have +2 Armor.
10056.lore: My feelings on the war in roseleaf are... complicated. Neither the bronze legion nor the red mist are threats to my people, and yet my cousins willingly intercede on the Vhoul's behalf. Their fondness for such frail creatures is strange to me, but none the less they call for my aid, and I am compelled to answer. — Rooftrellen, the Treant Protector

10058.name: Sorla Khan
10058.text_plain:
Warmonger
Sorla Khan deals +4 damage when attacking a tower.
10058.lore: I'm not oblivious to my reputation. I won't even pretend that it's un-earned. I've lead the Red Mist from town to town taking whatever it is we want... and what we want is to survive. So yes. I am a warlord. I have done and will do unspeakable things. But make no mistake, I am no conqueror. I am the Savior of the Oglodi. It's just an unfortunate reality that my people's salvation means your people's destruction. — Sorla, Khan of the Red Mist

10059.name: Necrophos
10059.text_plain:
Sadist
Modify Necrophos with +1 Health after an enemy neighbor dies.
10059.lore: For years I travelled, spreading the gift of pestilence city by city. But now a unique opportunity has arisen. If I can infect the Red Mist Horde... they can do the travelling for me, and pass along my gift faster than I could ever dream. — Rotund'jere, the Necrophos

10060.name: Lion
10060.text: [abilityname[Finger of Death]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■4:]] Deal 8 [g:508[piercing]] damage to a [g:607[unit]].  Quicken (reduce cooldown by 1, but not below 1).]]
10060.text_plain:
Finger of Death
Active 4: Deal 8 piercing damage to a unit. Quicken (reduce cooldown by 1, but not below 1).
10060.lore: I am a hunted man. The Court of Ristul seek my hand. The Anti-Mage, my head. Now I seek asylum in Weeping Rose, but first I must seek the Quorum's emissary. — Lion, the Demon Witch

10062.name: Skywrath Mage
10062.text: [abilityname[Concussive Shot]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Give a [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] -2 [g:504[Armor]] this round.]]
10062.text_plain:
Concussive Shot
Active 2: Give a hero and its allied neighbors -2 Armor this round.
10062.lore: I empathize with Rix. It's not easy following the orders of a leader you despise. But I don't have the luxury of staging a rebellion...the stakes are too high, and so I must bide my time... and wait to be reunited with my beloved. — Dragonus, the Skywrath Mage

10063.name: Mystic Flare
10063.text: Deal 12 damage evenly divided among a [g:607[unit]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]].
10063.text_plain: Deal 12 damage evenly divided among a unit and its allied neighbors.
10063.lore: I dedicated my life to the pursuit of the mystic arts...But while my head was buried in books, my beloved was betrayed and cast out of the Ghastly Eyrie. I was unable to save her then... but at least I have the power to save her now. — Skywrath Mage, Guilt-Wrecked

10064.name: Crystal Maiden
10064.text: [abilityname[Arcane Aura]]After the first time an allied [g:4[spell]] is played in each lane, restore 2 [g:511[Mana]] to the [g:2[tower]] in that lane.
10064.text_plain:
Arcane Aura
After the first time an allied spell is played in each lane, restore 2 Mana to the tower in that lane.
10064.lore: 'Warden of Icewrack.' It's a fancy title. In theory it means I'm responsible for maintaining law and order, collaborating with the Sapphire Conclave on magical crimes, and protecting the weak from all manners of nasty things. In practice I help farmers fix fences. So I decided to go on a little sabbatical. Besides... I couldn't stay in Icewrack. It's cold. It's boring. And I heard my sister was planning on visiting so I definitely had to get the hell outta there. — Rylai, the Crystal Maiden

10065.name: Zeus
10065.lore: I care little for the affairs of mortals. I have no stake in the war between the Red Mist and the Bronze Legion, and the plight of the Vhoul does little to stir my blood. What I DO care about however, is that charlatan Storm Spirit claiming my lightning as his own... and so I travel to Roseleaf; to prove that there is no god of lightning above me. — Zeus, Lord of Heaven

10067.name: Magnus
10067.lore: I'm no stranger to man's lust for conquest. To be seen not as a person but as a commodity... and I refuse to stand idly by while the Vhoul are subjugated. It's too late for my people... but it might not be too late for theirs. — Magnus, Endangered Protector

10068.name: Dark Seer
10068.text: [abilityname[Surge]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Move another ally to another lane.]]
10068.text_plain:
Surge
Active 2: Move another ally to another lane.
10068.lore: The Red Mist slowly marches to Stonehall. The Bronze Legion plans an ambush in Roseleaf. But the denizens of that Vhoul city do not take kindly to occupation and have sparked an insurrection. Three factions. One battlefield. And not a strategic mind between them. I will defeat these charlatans of war. And in doing so, prove my brilliance. — Ish'kafel, the Dark Seer

10069.name: Legion Commander
10069.text_plain:
Moment of Courage
Legion Commander has +2 Retaliate.
10069.lore: I know these people think me a monster. I don't blame them. No one wants to be occupied, but it's in their best interests! If we weren't here in Roseleaf the Red Mist would have slaughtered them all... today the Vhoul see us as villains, but after we defeat Sorla Khan... The Bronze Legion will be heralded as the heroes we are. — Tresdin, Legion Commander

10070.name: Ursa
10070.text: [abilityname[Fury Swipes]]When {s:thisCardName} deals [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:607[unit]], [g:401[modify]] that [g:607[unit]] with -1 [g:504[Armor]].
10070.text_plain:
Fury Swipes
When Ursa deals battle damage to a unit, modify that unit with -1 Armor.
10070.lore: This isn't my fight. But if I don't stand with the Vhoul it's only a matter of time before the Bronze Legion comes for my people. A message needs to be sent... and it will be bloody. — Ursa, Tribal Protector

10076.name: Smeevil Armsmaster
10076.text_plain: Play Effect: Modify a random allied hero with +2 Attack.
10076.lore: Greevils were terrible mistake. Smeevils were created to fix mistake. Greevils hurt. Smeevils help. For instance. I make swords that can be used to kill Greevils. And other people. But ideally Greevils. — Kareth, Smeevil Armsmaster

10077.name: Sister of the Veil
10077.text_plain: Active 1: Choose a combat target for Sister of the Veil.
10077.lore: My role is not to question, but to act. It doesn't matter if you are a pauper in the street, a king on a throne, or a mad wizard locked away in the Tyler Estate. If your name is given to me by The Veiled Sisters... your death is inevitable. The only question is when will I choose to take it. — Hetheel, Sister of the Veil

10078.name: Tyler Estate Censor
10078.lore: There is no such thing as forbidden magic in Weeping Rose. But some mistake the Quorums...open mindedness... as a license to be irresponsible. The Tyler Estate is what awaits those who would abuse the hospitality Weeping Rose provides. — Votajo, Tyler Estate Censor

10079.name: Smeevil Blacksmith
10079.text_plain: Play Effect: Modify a random allied hero with +1 Armor.
10079.lore: My needs are simple. A hammer. An anvil. And a master who appreciates my skill. The first two are easy to come by. The third is more elusive. Fortunately bad masters have a tendency to die in battle. Some say this is because of flaws in their armor. I say...'prove it?' — Vareth, Smeevil Blacksmith

10080.name: Rebel Decoy
10080.text_plain: Active 1: Swap Rebel Decoy with another ally.
10080.lore: I'll never forget the day I met Rix. It was in the early days of the revolution, when people were scared to even gather at night. We met in the tailor's wine cellar and Rix talked... god did he talk. Of passion. Of mistakes. Of his love for our people. I was mesmerized. We all were. So when he turned to me and asked what I could give to help the rebellion, there was only one answer... 'My life.' — Lyla, Rebel Decoy

10083.name: Pit Fighter of Quoidge
10083.text_plain: Modify Pit Fighter of Quoidge with +2 Attack after an allied neighbor dies.
10083.lore: I get it, I get it, 'The Fields of Endless Carnage' sounds like a horrible place to take a holiday but I'm tellin' you Quoidge is a great city filled with lovely people. If you ever make the trip be sure to stop by the fightin' pits and say hello. I may look different on account of the whole sewing-on-limbs thing but I'll remember you... I never forget a face. — Tristan, Undead Boxer and all around swell chap

10084.name: Rebel Instigator
10084.text: [g:202[After the combat phase]], if {s:thisCardName} dealt [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:1[creep]] this round, [g:409[summon]] a [[Rebel Instigator]].
10084.text_plain: After the combat phase, if Rebel Instigator dealt battle damage to a creep this round, summon a Rebel Instigator.
10084.lore: I'm not some wide-eyed pup with delusions of being a hero. I know what we're up against, and I know I'll be leaving my wife a widow. But this our home. How can I look my daughter in the eyes and say that when our only chance to free ourselves from the yoke of the bronze legion came I did nothing. That so many of our brothers died for nothing, that maybe things would have been different if I just tried. No. I know what I need to do. And when I'm finished others will as well. — Gorn, Rebel Instigator
effects: [g:202[After the combat phase]], if {s:thisCardName} dealt [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:1[creep]] this round, [g:409[summon]] a [[Rebel Instigator]].

10085.name: Assassin's Shadow
10085.text_plain: Siege 5. Assassin's Shadow has -2 Attack for each ally.
10085.lore: For the most powerful of our order... not even death removes us from our sacred duty. Our communion with the Phantom Veil is strong enough to let our spirit live on, long after our bodies have rot. The mortal coil is now behind me, and the presence of my sisters, while comforting, is a distraction from the work I must do. My list still has names on it...and I won't rest until they are dead. — Elsbeth, the Assassin's Shadow

10086.name: Disciple of Nevermore
10086.text_plain: Other allies have +2 Attack and -2 Armor.
10086.lore: There is delicious conflict here. And where there is conflict there is desperation. And where there is desperation there is blood to be shed and deals to be made. — Zo, Disciple of Nevermore

10087.name: Legion Standard Bearer
10087.text_plain: Legion Standard Bearer's allied neighbors have +4 Attack.
10087.lore: As a boy I dreamed of being a member of the Stonehall Elite... to be trained by Belasanno himself in the ways of war... but the sad truth is that I have no gift for combat. I am no soldier. But I am a believer. In our emperor. In our country. In our mission. I may not be a swordsman, but I am proud to carry the bullsnake into battle. — Pololo, Standard Bearer of the Bronze Legion

10090.name: Relentless Zombie
10090.text_plain: Play Effect: Give Relentless Zombie a Death Shield.
10090.lore: The dead are rising in Roseleaf, Knogh...someone took The Oath. — Vanessa, Heretic for Hire

10091.name: Revtel Convoy
10091.text: {s:thisCardName} has +X [g:509[Attack]] where X is equal to half your gold.
10091.text_plain: Revtel Convoy has +X Attack where X is equal to half your gold.
10091.lore: These are strange times in Revtel. Iron Fog is terrorized by Losel. The Veiled Sisters assassinated Kwerthias. And Lord Sunbreeze's own daughter has burned down his estate. But despite the setbacks, the wheel continues to turn and profits continue to roll in. But there is no time to mourn in Revtel... there is business to be done. — Lowenplatt, Merchant of Revtel
effects: {s:thisCardName} has +X [g:509[Attack]] where X is equal to half your gold.

10092.name: Oglodi Vandal
10092.text: [color:play_effect[[g:602[Play Effect]]:]]  Deal 4 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]].
10092.text_plain: Play Effect: Deal 4 damage to the enemy tower.
10092.lore: Besiege Stonehall. I've seen Khan's over thrown for even suggesting it. But when Sorla gave the order, not one of us batted an eye. Not because she's the strongest. Not because we fear her cruelty. But because we knew that she would die before she failed her people. And so The Red Mist marches... and may the gods have mercy on whoever stands in our way. — Seguri, Red Mist Vandal
effects: [color:play_effect[[g:602[Play Effect]]:]]  Deal 4 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]].

10093.name: Hound of War
10093.lore: They smell blood, but what they track is fear. — Kanna, Dire Child

10094.name: Mercenary Exiles
10094.text: [activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Spend all your gold. [g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with +X [g:509[Attack]] and +X [g:510[Health]] where X is half the gold spent.]]
10094.text_plain: Active 2: Spend all your gold. Modify Mercenary Exiles with +X Attack and +X Health where X is half the gold spent.
10094.lore: We were good soldiers that served Galanius and the Bronze Legion for years. The blood we spilt didn't just bring glory to Stonehall, it helped build the whole damn empire. And how were we rewarded? With a fancy piece of red cloth to wear into battle. But you can't build a keep out of honor. You can't feed your family with Pride. You can't repay a debt with Glory. So now we fight for the only thing that matters. Gold. — Tessgan, leader of the Black Hilt Mercenary Company

10095.name: Keenfolk Golem
10095.lore: Mazzie is horrible at lots of things. Being dependable. Staying sober. Keeping secrets. But I'll give him credit: he knows how to build a giant robot. — Tinker, Humbled Inventor

10096.name: Emissary of the Quorum
10096.text_plain: Active 1: Modify allies with +2 Attack and +2 Health.
10096.lore: The more judgmental call Weeping Rose a place where magic is unfettered by morality... a chaotic city of delights and horrors. And they would be partially right. The city was founded on the idea that 'good magic' and 'evil magic' are labels created by lesser minds... But there is no chaos in Weeping Rose... The Quorum ensures that is the case. And it is on their behalf that I have traveled here. — The Emissary of the Quorum

10097.name: Marrowfell Brawler
10097.lore: Every year my clan comes to Roseleaf for the Thunderhide migration... and while the denizens of Roseleaf were a minor nuisance we never bothered to hunt them... they were too frail to make a worthy trophy. But now things have changed. This 'Rix' has stirred their blood and now they fancy themselves warriors... perhaps it's time to start a new hunt. — Mavor, Marrowfell Brawler

10102.name: Thunderhide Pack
10102.lore: When hunting Thunderhides, you always come home with new scars...if you come home at all. — Warrunner warns his hunters

10103.name: Ogre Corpse Tosser
10103.text: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] after an allied [[Melee Creep]] dies.
10103.text_plain: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower after an allied Melee Creep dies.
10103.lore: Friends said throwing dead bodies was hobby, not real job. Who's laughing now? Not friends. I kill them for not supporting my dream. — Lommett, Ogre Corpse Tosser
effects: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] after an allied [[Melee Creep]] dies.

10104.name: Bronze Legionnaire
10104.lore: The Red Mist Horde is on the march, looting and destroying every city that stands between them and our great capital of Stonehall. If we wish to protect our home...if we wish to stop these monsters... we must be willing to do whatever it takes. — Decius, Bronze Legionnaire

10106.name: Incarnation of Selemene
10106.text: Fully restore your [g:2[tower]]'s [g:511[Mana]] after you play any card.
10106.text_plain: Fully restore your tower's Mana after you play any card.
10106.lore: Like any mother, I've had to watch as harm befalls my children... hoping that by not intervening they would learn how to navigate this cruel and unfeeling world. But sometimes... sometimes the cries of my beloved are too loud for me not to answer — Selemene, Godess of the Moon
effects: Fully restore your [g:2[tower]]'s [g:511[Mana]] after you play any card.

10107.name: Vhoul Martyr
10107.text_plain: Death Effect: Modify allies with +1 Attack and +1 Health.
10107.lore: I knew this day would come the moment I agreed to host Rix's gatherings in my wine cellar... but I wasn't ready for what it felt like to be pulled from my home in the middle of the night. I know it's only a matter of time before Tresdin has me executed, and I won't lie. I'm scared. But we all have our parts to play. — Papa Samet, Vhoul Martyr

10108.name: Thunderhide Alpha
10108.lore: The Alpha is a fearsome beast, capable of untold destruction... only the strongest of centaurs dare to stand in its presence, let alone fight it one on one. — Warrunner on the trail of the Alpha

10111.name: Satyr Duelist
10111.text_plain: Modify Satyr Duelist with +2 Attack after the combat phase.
10111.lore: I am not a swordsman. I am artist. Now, I'm not foolish enough to boast that none are my equal, after all the world is filled with exceptional individuals...but I am wise enough to know that I am better than most. — Trivian, the Satyr Duelist

10112.name: Savage Wolf
10112.text_plain: Modify Savage Wolf with +1 Attack and +2 Health after the combat phase.
10112.lore: My family was taken from me; but in my solitude I found a new family... and they will help me have my revenge. — Lycan, Pack Leader

10113.name: Rampaging Hellbear
10113.text_plain: Modify Rampaging Hellbear with +4 Attack after the combat phase.
10113.lore: Kwerthias took great pride in his menagerie, though ultimately it led to his undoing. The Phantom Assassin unleashed his pets in the palace... while his guards were focused on his beasts... she slit his throat. — The Brass Herald giving respect where it is due

10114.name: Cursed Satyr
10114.text: [g:409[Summon]] a [[Zombie]] for your opponent [g:202[after the combat phase]].
10114.text_plain: Summon a Zombie for your opponent after the combat phase.
10114.lore: I'm not proud of what I've done, we were children playing games... how could I've expected what would come, what she was willing to awaken. Death is coming for us all now... but it is most certainly coming for me first. — Giamma, the Cursed Satyr
effects: [g:409[Summon]] a [[Zombie]] for your opponent [g:202[after the combat phase]].

10115.name: Ravenhook
10115.text: [activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] [g:408[Condemn]] a random [g:5[item]] equipped by the [g:607[unit]] blocking {s:thisCardName}. Get gold equal to the base cost of that [g:5[item]].]]
10115.text_plain: Active 1: Condemn a random item equipped by the unit blocking Ravenhook. Get gold equal to the base cost of that item.
10115.lore: I'm not oblivious to the reputation I have; after all, the visits my brothers and sisters make are... rarely social. But it's not my fault I'm here, it's yours. Maybe you stole from your noble father... perhaps you defaulted on a Revtel debt... or could it be something as pedestrian as revenge... Eh, who's to say, the 'whys' don't matter do they? No. All that matters is that there is something you hold dear, and my employer wants me to take it from you. — Jorbiah, the Ravenhook

10116.name: Ravenous Mass
10116.text_plain: Active 1: Condemn Ravenous Mass's allied neighbors. Modify Ravenous Mass with their Attack and Health.
10116.lore: In the Fields of Endless Carnage, the dead can never die... leading to the creation of grotesque perversions such as these. — Lady Anshu expresses her scorn

10117.name: Roseleaf Druid
10117.lore: To fight alongside Rooftrellen is a great honor. With his help I have no doubt that these trespassers will be removed in no time. But even still, sometimes I am filled with doubt. Today it is the Red Mist and Bronze Legion. Tomorrow it will be the keen. When will the despoiling of our home ever end... — Aubgraw, Roseleaf Druid

10118.name: Hellbear Crippler
10118.text: When {s:thisCardName} deals [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:607[unit]], [g:401[modify]] that [g:607[unit]] with -1 [g:509[Attack]].
10118.text_plain: When Hellbear Crippler deals battle damage to a unit, modify that unit with -1 Attack.
10118.lore: Any centaur worth his skinning knife can kill a Hellbear. The real trick is doing it without getting scarred. — Bradwarden remains unimpressed
effects: When {s:thisCardName} deals [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:607[unit]], [g:401[modify]] that [g:607[unit]] with -1 [g:509[Attack]].

10119.name: Selfish Cleric
10119.text_plain: Fully heal Selfish Cleric after the combat phase.
10119.lore: For generations the Rumusque Faithful have defended the living world from the abominations that slink from the Fields of Endless Carnage. We were known as men and women of principle. Of valor. Of Devotion. And then Necrophos tried to destroy us all. — Abajen, Rumusque Cleric

10127.name: Ogre Conscript
10127.lore: The Bronze Legion brings peace, the stupid Vhoul bring chaos. Like Rix I joined the Legion. Unlike Rix I'm loyal. Soon the rebellion will be finished, perhaps then Commander Tresdin will let me eat Vhoul. — Tox Armripper, Bronze Legion Conscript

10128.name: Untested Grunt
10128.lore: I know my parents feel betrayed that I left with the Red Mist. My path was set to be an artisan... but they didn't see Sorla Khan stand in the marketplace. They didn't hear her talk about the old ways. About how the Red Mist isn't about destroying the past but protecting it. Honoring it. Together we're going to build a better future for the Oglodi. — Nalon, the Untested Grunt

10129.name: Assassin's Apprentice
10129.text_plain: Active 1: Choose a combat target for Assassin's Apprentice.
10129.lore: The Revtel campaign was successful, but I was only there to observe, not take part... they say I'm not ready to kill on my own... but I'll prove them wrong. — Myrian, the Assassin's Apprentice

10131.name: Stonehall Elite
10131.text: [g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with +2 [g:509[Attack]] and +2 [g:510[Health]] after a [g:607[unit]] blocking it dies.
10131.text_plain: Modify Stonehall Elite with +2 Attack and +2 Health after a unit blocking it dies.
10131.lore: The Bronze Legion is Stonehall's first line of defense. But sometimes the threats to our great nation don't come from external forces... they come from within. Situations like Rix's betrayal are why Belasanno formed the Stonehall Elite, and it will be my privilege to end this rebellion. — Tyber, member of the Stonehall Elite
effects: [g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with +2 [g:509[Attack]] and +2 [g:510[Health]] after a [g:607[unit]] blocking it dies.

10132.name: Red Mist Pillager
10132.text: [g:202[After the combat phase]], if {s:thisCardName} dealt [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:2[tower]] this round, [g:409[summon]] a [[Red Mist Pillager]].
10132.text_plain: After the combat phase, if Red Mist Pillager dealt battle damage to a tower this round, summon a Red Mist Pillager.
10132.lore: The Bronze Legion thinks they can stop us at Roseleaf, but already the cracks are showing. Tresdin is delusional if she thinks she can fight Rix's rebellion and the Red Mist. No. Stonehall will fall. It's only a matter of time. — Mial, Red Mist Pillager
effects: [g:202[After the combat phase]], if {s:thisCardName} dealt [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:2[tower]] this round, [g:409[summon]] a [[Red Mist Pillager]].

10133.name: Champion of the Ancient
10133.text: [color:play_effect[[g:602[Play Effect]]:]]  [g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with +1 [g:509[Attack]], +1 [g:510[Health]], and +1 [g:502[Cleave]] for each enemy.
10133.text_plain: Play Effect: Modify Champion of the Ancient with +1 Attack, +1 Health, and +1 Cleave for each enemy.
10133.lore: My people have pledged their lives in service to the ancient... offering ourselves to be a tide of flesh that will protect the Radiant from Kanna and her Dire heretics. Thanks to the blessing of the Radiant, I have become the crashing wave of that tide... and I will give the Dire something to fear. — Breno, the Champion of the Ancient
effects: [color:play_effect[[g:602[Play Effect]]:]]  [g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with +1 [g:509[Attack]], +1 [g:510[Health]], and +1 [g:502[Cleave]] for each enemy.

10134.name: Roseleaf Rejuvenator
10134.lore: The Treants of Roseleaf and the Vhoul have lived together peacefully for generations. But now interlopers have turned our home into a battlefield. We have made the call to our cousins in the Vale of Augery. The vhoul must be protected... and those that would despoil this place must be destroyed. — Springwind, the Roseleaf Rejuvenator

10136.name: Loyal Beast
10136.text: When {s:thisCardName} deals [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:607[unit]], [g:401[modify]] that [g:607[unit]] with -1 [g:509[Attack]].
10136.text_plain: When Loyal Beast deals battle damage to a unit, modify that unit with -1 Attack.
10136.lore: This forest has been my home for many years... and its denizens are quick to come to my aid. — Beastmaster, Friend of the Forest
effects: When {s:thisCardName} deals [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:607[unit]], [g:401[modify]] that [g:607[unit]] with -1 [g:509[Attack]].

10137.name: Satyr Magician
10137.text_plain: Active 1: Fully restore your tower's Mana.
10137.lore: Power. Immortality. Revenge. These are the three biggest reasons people seek mastery of the arcane arts. But they are not my reasons. I pursue magic because it makes anything possible... and if anything is possible then hope, no matter how remote, can never die. — Allegra, Satyr Magician

10138.name: Troll Soothsayer
10138.text: Draw an extra card each round.
10138.text_plain: Draw an extra card each round.
10138.lore: The Red Mist Horde is just the beginning. Another force is coming. I've felt it in the winds and seen it in the bones. Something Dark. Something Seductive. Something Evil. If we don't prepare for its arrival, it will certainly consume us all. — Ruseth, Troll Soothsayer
effects: Draw a card before the card draw phase.

10141.name: Assured Destruction
10141.lore: The difference between victory and defeat is the willingness to make unconscionable choices and sacrifice everything. — Sorla Khan, Destroyer

10142.name: Corrosive Mist
10142.lore: I am able to thrive in... less hospitable environs. — Viper, Ultimate Survivor

10147.name: Barracks
10147.text: [g:409[Summon]] a [[Melee Creep]] into this lane each [g:204[deployment phase]].
10147.text_plain: Summon a Melee Creep into this lane each deployment phase.
10147.lore: More of the faithful come by the day... and they will need a home to house them. — Prellex, Bringer of the Faithful
effects: [g:409[Summon]] a [[Melee Creep]] into this lane each [g:204[deployment phase]].

10148.name: Fractured Timeline
10148.text: [g:200[Before the action phase]], give a random card in opponent's hand +1 [g:407[Lock]].
10148.text_plain: Before the action phase, give a random card in opponent's hand +1 Lock.
10148.lore: I respect the Claszureme Treaty and the human wizard that helped broker it. As such I would never rewrite time for my own amusement... however, I think it's healthy to remind the Sapphire Conclave what I am capable of; lest they grow complacent and fail to live up to their end of the bargain. — Faceless Void, Lord of Claszureme
effects: [g:200[Before the action phase]], give a random card in opponent's hand +1 [g:407[Lock]].

10149.name: Unearthed Secrets
10149.text: Draw a card [g:202[after the combat phase]] if your [g:2[tower]] was dealt damage this round.
10149.text_plain: Draw a card after the combat phase if your tower was dealt damage this round.
10149.lore: For so long I was afraid to return home...but the time has come to confront the past. — Lycan, Last Son of House Ambry
effects: Draw a card [g:202[after the combat phase]] if your [g:2[tower]] was dealt damage this round.

10150.name: Path of the Cunning
10150.text: After you play a [color:black[black card]], [g:401[modify]] a random ally with +1 [g:501[Siege]].
10150.text_plain: After you play a black card, modify a random ally with +1 Siege.
10150.lore: What if I told you that there is always a better solution than the one immediately before you. That horrific wars could have been avoided with negotiation or the strategic removal of individuals. If what I said rings true to you... perhaps you should walk The Path of the Cunning. — Jolixia assesses The Murderer
effects: After you play a [color:black[black card]], [g:401[modify]] a random ally with +1 [g:501[Siege]].

10151.name: Path of the Wise
10151.text: After you play a [color:blue[blue card]], deal 1 [g:508[piercing]] damage to a random enemy.
10151.text_plain: After you play a blue card, deal 1 piercing damage to a random enemy.
10151.lore: What if I told you that most are not fit to lead. That to rule effectively you need to be willing to keep secrets from your own people, and that sentimentality makes you unable to make the right decisions when stakes are high. If what I said rings true to you... perhaps you should walk The Path of the Wise. — Jolixia assesses The Warden
effects: After you play a [color:blue[blue card]], deal 1 [g:508[piercing]] damage to a random enemy.

10152.name: Path of the Dreamer
10152.text: After you play a [color:green[green card]], give your [g:2[tower]] +3 [g:505[Regeneration]] until end of round.
10152.text_plain: After you play a green card, give your tower +3 Regeneration until end of round.
10152.lore: What if I told you that we don't have to accept the world as it is? That people all too often confuse 'the difficult' with 'the impossible' and in doing so close their minds and hearts to wondrous possibilities. If what I said rings true to you... perhaps you should walk The Path of the Dreamer. — Jolixia assesses The Scholar
effects: After you play a [color:green[green card]], give your [g:2[tower]] +3 [g:505[Regeneration]] until end of round.

10153.name: Path of the Bold
10153.text: After you play a [color:red[red card]], [g:401[modify]] a random ally with +1 [g:509[Attack]].
10153.text_plain: After you play a red card, modify a random ally with +1 Attack.
10153.lore: What if I told you that not everyone is special. That there are some people who are destined for greatness, and it is through their skill, dedication, and will that great works are accomplished. If what I said rings true to you... perhaps you should walk The Path of the Bold. — Jolixia assesses The Adventurer
effects: After you play a [color:red[red card]], [g:401[modify]] a random ally with +1 [g:509[Attack]].

10154.name: The Tyler Estate
10154.lore: Most of the magical world acknowledges the authority of the Sapphire Conclave. But in Weeping Rose we govern ourselves, answering only to The Quorum, a senate of 31 powerful wizards. And while Weeping Rose is not home to many rules, the few we have are obeyed without question. Because to fail to do so is to be sent to the Tyler Estate. — Vanessa, 'law abiding' citizen of Weeping Rose

10155.name: Homefield Advantage
10155.text: [g:200[Before the action phase]] [g:404[disarm]] a random enemy this round.
10155.text_plain: Before the action phase disarm a random enemy this round.
10155.lore: The armor the bronze legion wears makes them tough to kill, but surprisingly easy to outrun... — Enchantress, Conscientious Objector
effects: [g:200[Before the action phase]] [g:404[disarm]] a random enemy this round.

10156.name: Bitter Enemies
10156.text: [g:202[After the combat phase]], remove a charge from {s:thisCardName}. [g:200[Before the action phase]], if there are zero charges on {s:thisCardName}, deal 6 damage to both [g:2[towers]].
10156.text_plain: After the combat phase, remove a charge from Bitter Enemies. Before the action phase, if there are zero charges on Bitter Enemies, deal 6 damage to both towers.
10156.lore:
'Look around you commander, this is what awaits your beloved Stonehall.'

'You're very confident for a woman who's about to die.

'You have a high opinion of yourself.'

'No. Just a very poor one of you.'
— Roseleaf in flames
effects: [g:200[Before the action phase]], if there are zero charges on {s:thisCardName}, deal 6 damage to both [g:2[towers]].

10157.name: Conflagration
10157.text: Deal 2 damage to each enemy [g:200[before the action phase]].
10157.text_plain: Deal 2 damage to each enemy before the action phase.
10157.lore: We may sort of hate each other, but at the end of the day if I was going to war I'd want her on my side. — Crystal Maiden, Twin Sister
effects: Deal 2 damage to each enemy [g:200[before the action phase]].

10160.name: Ignite
10160.text: Deal 1 [g:508[piercing]] damage to each enemy [g:200[before the action phase]].
10160.text_plain: Deal 1 piercing damage to each enemy before the action phase.
10160.lore:
'I think we're probably the first person to figure out that fire can be used not just to cook meat. But also light people on fire.'
'If not the first, definitely in the top five.' — Ogre Magi, Innovator
effects: Deal 1 [g:508[piercing]] damage to each enemy [g:200[before the action phase]].

10161.name: Trebuchets
10161.text: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] [g:200[before the action phase]].
10161.text_plain: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower before the action phase.
10161.lore: I almost feel sorry for Tresdin, were it not for Rix her little ambush may have worked. But in the end, the Bronze Legion cannot wage a two front war. — Sorla Khan seizes the moment
effects: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] [g:200[before the action phase]].

10162.name: Unsupervised Artillery
10162.text: [activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] Deal 4 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]]. May only be used if there are no [g:606[unblocked]] enemies.]]
10162.text_plain: Active 1: Deal 4 piercing damage to the enemy tower. May only be used if there are no unblocked enemies.
10162.lore: Yes you can find cheaper alternatives to the Jasper Circle, but you almost always get what you pay for. — Lorlin Lasan, Dealmaker

10164.name: Revtel Investments
10164.text:
Add a charge to {s:thisCardName} [g:202[after the combat phase]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] Get 4 gold for each charge. [g:408[Condemn]] {s:thisCardName}.]]
10164.text_plain:
Add a charge to Revtel Investments after the combat phase.

Active 1: Get 4 gold for each charge. Condemn Revtel Investments.
10164.lore: Revtel is the result of 3 different societies uniting to build something better. Each of the Merchant Kings brings a...unique perspective on how to do business, but all of us have an eye for profit. — The Brass Herald, Merchant King of Revtel

10165.name: Iron Fog Goldmine
10165.text_plain: Get 3 gold after the combat phase.
10165.lore: Iron Fog. A city of industry. Of Precision. Of perfection. I guided not only its constrution, but its conception. And while some take issue with our labor practices, the results speak for themselves. — The Brass Herald, King of Iron Fog

10168.name: Selemene's Favor
10168.lore: Lead by Luna, the Dark Moon worship Selemene, goddess of magic and the moon. To underestimate their power is to court disaster — Omniknight, Theologist

10169.name: Mist of Avernus
10169.text_plain: Modify allies with +1 Attack before the action phase.
10169.lore: True power awaits those who bathe in the Mist of Avernus... — Abaddon, Keeper of the Mist of Avernus

10170.name: Altar of the Mad Moon
10170.lore: Mother sings of the Radiant's benevolence... but I've seen what the Radiant truly wants. What it is willing to do. And I will never be its slave. — Kanna, Reborn by the Dire

10171.name: Howling Mind
10171.text: You and your opponent draw an extra card each round.
10171.text_plain: You and your opponent draw an extra card each round.
10171.lore: It doesn't happen often, but every now and again a wizard is allowed to leave the Tyler Estate... though when they do they are irreparably changed. — Vanessa, Occult Investigator
effects: Draw a card and opponent draws a card before the card draw phase.

10172.name: Temple of War
10172.text_plain: All equipped heroes have +2 Attack and +1 Armor.
10172.lore: Our god is strange to the Vhoul. I understand. Once She was strange to me. But in time they will learn to love her as we do. — Legion Commander on the repurposing of a Vhoul place of worship

10173.name: Nether Ward
10173.text: After opponent plays a [g:4[spell]], deal 3 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]].
10173.text_plain: After opponent plays a spell, deal 3 damage to the enemy tower.
10173.lore: You could tell me that there are more sublime things than watching a wizard slowly kill themselves... but I'm not sure I'd believe you. — Pugna, Maniacal Tormentor
effects: After opponent plays a [g:4[spell]], deal 3 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]].

10174.name: Burning Oil
10174.lore: I know Sorla's tactics...when her men come to scale these walls they will find an unpleasant surprise. — Legion Commander plans to secure Roseleaf

10175.name: Aghanim's Sanctum
10175.text_plain: Active 1: Fully restore your tower's Mana.
10175.lore: Aghanim is the greatest wizard of all time. There is no question. There is no debate. No one is his equal. So when he vanished one day, we never wondered 'how' we wondered 'why'. Some say he feared for his life and ran into hiding, but I don't believe that for a second. You ask me, Aghanim is working on something. Something important. Something that will change the world. — Vanessa, on Aghanim's disappearance

10176.name: Escape Route
10176.text_plain: Active 1: Return an allied hero to the Fountain.
10176.lore: Losel. We both know who wants you dead... and we both know the wealth they command. However, seeing as I’m sitting here talking and not hiding your family’s bodies it should be obvious that the Jasper Circle has not been extended a contract yet. And while there is good money in murder, there’s also a lot of effort in it and I’m a busy man. So, if you were to say, hire the Jasper Circle to smuggle you out of town safely, I would be forced to tell the gentleman whom I’m meeting tonight that my services are already under retainer. Regardless of what you choose, our paths will cross again this evening... but the circumstances of that visit are entirely up to you. — Lorlin Lasan, Leader of the Jasper Circle

10177.name: Assault Ladders
10177.text: Allies deal +2 damage when attacking a [g:2[tower]].
10177.text_plain: Allies deal +2 damage when attacking a tower.
10177.lore: There is no city so secure that it's out of the Red Mist's reach. Anything is possible given enough preparation. — Sorla Khan, Warmonger
effects: Allies deal +2 damage when attacking a [g:2[tower]].

10178.name: Grand Melee
10178.text: If there is an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]] in this lane, all [g:0[heroes]] have +2 [g:502[Cleave]].
10178.text_plain: If there is an allied red hero in this lane, all heroes have +2 Cleave.
10178.lore: You can always judge a bar by the quality of the fights that break out. So when looking for a place to drink at, try to find one where the blood is stained into the wood. That's the Axe seal of approval — An excerpt from 'Axe's Guide to Travel'
effects: If there is an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]] in this lane, all [g:0[heroes]] have +2 [g:502[Cleave]].

10179.name: Steel Reinforcement
10179.lore: When you have a whole town looking to destroy your workshop, you get pretty good at reinforcing buildings. — Mazzie, People Person

10180.name: Messenger Rookery
10180.text: [activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] Choose an ally. Choose a combat target for it.]]
10180.text_plain: Active 1: Choose an ally. Choose a combat target for it.
10180.lore: The holdings of Revtel are vast, and so the Merchant Kings rely on Wildwing messengers to communicate between the capital and our lands. — The Brass Herald, Lover of Efficiency

10181.name: Cheating Death
10181.text: [activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] Give a [g:607[unit]] a [g:506[Death Shield]] this round. May only be used if there is an [color:green[allied green [g:0[hero]]]] in this lane.]]
10181.text_plain: Active 1: Give a unit a Death Shield this round. May only be used if there is an allied green hero in this lane.
10181.lore: The Narrow Maze is a nightmarish labyrinth where the souls of dead Heroes are given a chance to return to the living. Axe claims that he's escaped it twice, but I don't believe him... mainly for two reasons. 1: You can't kill Axe. 2. Even if he DID die, he would punch death in the face before he could be taken to the narrow maze. — Goodkind on metaphysics

10182.name: The Oath
10182.text: You can not play [g:4[spells]] or [g:1[creeps]] while this is the active lane. If there is an [color:black[allied black [g:0[hero]]]] in this lane, allies have +4 [g:509[Attack]].
10182.text_plain: You can not play spells or creeps while this is the active lane. If there is an allied black hero in this lane, allies have +4 Attack.
10182.lore: I know why you're here. Despite all your intentions and ambitions, things didn't go as planned and you need help. Help that the Court of Ristul is willing to provide; but before we lend you our strength, there's something we need you to do... — Nevermore, of the Court of Ristul
effects: If there is an [color:black[allied black [g:0[hero]]]] in this lane, allies have +4 [g:509[Attack]].

10183.name: The Omexe Arena
10183.text: Draw a card after a [g:0[hero]] dies.
10183.text_plain: Draw a card after a hero dies.
10183.lore: The Omexe Arena is where I made a name for myself. I was its champion, and no one was my equal. — Bradwarden reflects on his glory days
effects: Draw a card after a [g:0[hero]] dies.

10184.name: Keenfolk Turret
10184.text_plain: Active 1: Deal 2 piercing damage to a unit.
10184.lore: They're not particularly mobile, but they do the job when it comes to defending your workshop — Sniper wants people off his lawn

10185.name: Steam Cannon
10185.text: [activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] Deal 4 [g:508[piercing]] damage to a [g:607[unit]] in any lane.]]
10185.text_plain: Active 1: Deal 4 piercing damage to a unit in any lane.
10185.lore: Sniper asked me to design him a gun. I got over excited. — Tinker, Founding Member of the S.O.L.K.

10187.name: Glyph of Confusion
10187.text: Whenever any [g:607[unit]] enters this lane, [g:405[stun]] it this round.
10187.text_plain: Whenever any unit enters this lane, stun it this round.
10187.lore: It is a nasty world out there, and when a non-trivial percentage of it would like to see you dead you learn to take certain precautionary measures. — Vanessa, People Person
effects: Whenever any [g:607[unit]] enters this lane, [g:405[stun]] it this round.

10191.name: Routed
10191.text: [g:401[Modify]] enemy [g:0[heroes]] at the [g:300[Fountain]] with -X [g:509[Attack]] where X is half their [g:509[Attack]]. [g:401[Modify]] them with "Your [g:2[tower]] has -1 [g:511[Mana]]."
10191.text_plain: Modify enemy heroes at the Fountain with -X Attack where X is half their Attack. Modify them with "Your tower has -1 Mana."
10191.lore: If you want a battle to truly end, you must be relentless... even when the enemy is broken. — Legion Commander explains her philosophy on victory

10192.name: Rumusque Blessing
10192.text: Choose a lane. [g:401[Modify]] allies in that lane with +3 [g:510[Health]].
10192.text_plain: Choose a lane. Modify allies in that lane with +3 Health.
10192.lore: Go forth and do good. Through your deeds may the humble be inspired to greatness; and the plans of the wicked made undone. — traditional blessing of the Rumusque

10193.name: Verdant Refuge
10193.lore: I'm not a fighter. I'm a protector. It's not too late for you to walk away, but if you try to hurt these people, I promise it will not go well for you. — Enchantress takes a stand

10194.name: Watchtower
10194.text: Whenever an enemy [g:3[improvement]] enters this lane, draw a card.
10194.text_plain: Whenever an enemy improvement enters this lane, draw a card.
10194.lore: Kanna's forces are always a threat... we must remain vigilant. — Prellex, Mother of Sorrow
effects: Whenever an enemy [g:3[improvement]] enters this lane, draw a card.

10196.name: ...And One For Me
10196.text: Choose a [g:0[hero]].  Put a base copy of a random [g:5[item]] equipped by that [g:0[hero]] into your hand.
10196.text_plain: Choose a hero. Put a base copy of a random item equipped by that hero into your hand.
10196.lore:
'Where we come from; when an Ogre wants something, they tend just to kill whoever's holding it.'
'But since we couldn't exactly do that, we invented a process of giving and taking items without murder.'
'It's like sharing.'
'But better, because we came up with it.' — Ogre Magi, His Own Best Friend

10198.name: Rolling Storm
10198.text: Deal 2 damage to all [g:2[towers]] in all lanes.
10198.text_plain: Deal 2 damage to all towers in all lanes.
10198.lore: The worst part of meeting up with Zeus is the posturing we have to go through before we have a serious conversation. — Storm Spirit, Rising Storm

10202.name: Assassin's Veil
10202.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +4 [g:510[Health]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Choose a combat target for equipped [g:0[hero]].]]
10202.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +4 Health.

Active 2: Choose a combat target for equipped hero.
10202.lore: To bolster their numbers, the Sisters of the Veil often abduct children and train them in their ways. When they come of age, they are bestowed this in preparation of their first kill. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10203.name: Phase Boots
10203.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +4 [g:510[Health]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Swap equipped [g:0[hero]] with another ally.]]
10203.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +4 Health.

Active 2: Swap equipped hero with another ally.
10203.lore: To many this pair of boots seems like a lesser magical item... but in the right hands these can turn the tide of any battle. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10205.name: Stonehall Cloak
10205.text: Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +4 [g:510[Health]]. [g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with "Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +2 [g:510[Health]]" [g:202[after the combat phase]].
10205.text_plain: Equipped hero has +4 Health. Modify Stonehall Cloak with "Equipped hero has +2 Health" after the combat phase.
10205.lore: The bullsnake is a fitting symbol for Stonehall. They conquer. They occupy. They move on. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10206.name: Blink Dagger
10206.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +2 [g:509[Attack]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Move equipped [g:0[hero]] to another lane.]]
10206.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +2 Attack.

Active 2: Move equipped hero to another lane.
10206.lore: For years Axe has yearned to trade out his blink dagger for a blink axe, and for years Goodkind has had to remind him that blink axes don't exist. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10207.name: Revtel Signet Ring
10207.text_plain: Equipped hero has +4 Health and -3 Bounty.
10207.lore: Three nations collectively make up The Merchant Kingdom of Revtel. And while each of the Merchant Kings is recognized as sovereign within their own lands, in the Revtel capital, each are equal. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10208.name: Barbed Mail
10208.text_plain: Equipped hero has +1 Armor and +2 Retaliate.
10208.lore: You have to be really careful when you put this thing on. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10210.name: Demagicking Maul
10210.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +2 [g:509[Attack]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] [g:408[Condemn]] a random enemy [g:3[improvement]]. May only be used if equipped [g:0[hero]] is [g:606[unblocked]].]]
10210.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +2 Attack.

Active 1: Condemn a random enemy improvement. May only be used if equipped hero is unblocked.
10210.lore: Magic can be more fragile than most people think. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10211.name: Obliterating Orb
10211.lore: In the right hands, this orb can undermine the most well laid of plans... naturally Vanessa always keeps a few in her possession. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10212.name: Blade of the Vigil
10212.text_plain: Equipped hero has +2 Attack and +4 Cleave.
10212.lore: The Knights of the Vigil were renowned for their skill in battle. The stories of Sven, Geeta the Wildblade, and Klemens have captured the imagination of so many... you can't throw a rock in the Gardens of Freth without hitting a group of school kids recreating their adventures. But playing a knight is easy... wielding one of their swords is far more challenging. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10213.name: Fur-lined Mantle
10213.lore: Icewrack is not a clever name. It's cold there. Very cold. And those that don't dress for the weather won't be around long enough to enjoy the view. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10214.name: Chainmail
10214.lore: Leather armor is cheaper, but you get what you pay for. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10215.name: Broadsword
10215.lore: Perfect for the warrior on a budget. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10216.name: Golden Ticket
10216.text: Get a random [g:5[item]] from the Secret Shop.
10216.text_plain: Get a random item from the Secret Shop.
10216.lore: In Revtel everyone is looking for a bargain... — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10217.name: Rumusque Vestments
10217.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +1 Armor.

Active 2: Heal a unit 4.
10217.lore: The warrior priests of the Rumusque Faithful are led by Lady Anshu, and their mere presence can bolster the hearts of the virtuous — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10218.name: Keenfolk Musket
10218.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +2 [g:509[Attack]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Deal 2 damage to a [g:607[unit]].]]
10218.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +2 Attack.

Active 2: Deal 2 damage to a unit.
10218.lore: The Keenfolk are a clever people always looking for a way to use science to improve things... even warfare. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10220.name: Ring of Tarrasque
10220.text_plain: Equipped hero has +4 Health and +6 Regeneration.
10220.lore: Some say this ring can let it's bearer live forever. Naturally that's an exaggeration, a Tarrasque itself isn't an immortal creature, though it does make you wonder... if this ring is fashioned out of bone and muscle, what could someone do with a Tarrasque's heart? — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10222.name: Bracers of Sacrifice
10222.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +2 [g:504[Armor]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] Deal 6 damage to equipped [g:0[hero]]'s [g:600[enemy neighbors]] and [g:408[condemn]] equipped [g:0[hero]].]]
10222.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +2 Armor.

Active 1: Deal 6 damage to equipped hero's enemy neighbors and condemn equipped hero.
10222.lore: In Xhacatocatl, High Priests don these bracers when preparing to make an offering to the Flayed Twins. So devout are the priests in their faith, that if a suitable sacrifice can not be found to please The Twins, they are willing to offer themselves instead. Well, "willing" is relative, some try to make a run for it and are tied down screaming, but generally they're all on board. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10223.name: Red Mist Maul
10223.text_plain: Equipped hero has +2 Attack and +5 Siege.
10223.lore: Long ago, the Oglodi capital was a shining beacon of art and philosophy... and then they met the Tarnsmen.
