A barbarous group of demon worshipers, the Tarns lay siege to the Oglodi's great city, sating their bloodlust on any they could find. It was a massacre. The battle ended, only because the Tarns grew bored... and left a great civilization in ashes. Ever a resilient people, the Oglodi rebuilt and started again... referring to the razing of their capital as 'The Bleak Day'. But for some rebuilding was not enough. They believed that forsaking the martial in favor of the esoteric is what led to their down fall... and so they left and formed the first Red Mist Horde. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10224.name: Helm of the Dominator
10224.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +3 [g:504[Armor]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Get control of an enemy [g:1[creep]].]]
10224.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +3 Armor.

Active 2: Get control of an enemy creep.
10224.lore: It takes the blackest of hearts to be willing to bend the wills of men. Or you could be Chen. Chen does it all the time. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10225.name: Vesture of the Tyrant
10225.text: Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +3 [g:504[Armor]] and [g:610[Rapid Deployment]]. Your [g:2[tower]] has +3 [g:504[Armor]].
10225.text_plain: Equipped hero has +3 Armor and Rapid Deployment. Your tower has +3 Armor.
10225.lore: To say Galanius is a polarizing figure is an understatement. The Emperor of Stonehall is seen by many of his people as a savior who brought them safety... to others he is a merciless conqueror that has destroyed their people's way of life. But no matter their position, everyone knows better than to publically question his authority. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10226.name: Wingfall Hammer
10226.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +4 [g:509[Attack]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] Give equipped [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] +X [g:505[Regeneration]] this round where X is half its [g:509[Attack]].]]
10226.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +4 Attack.

Active 1: Give equipped hero and its allied neighbors +X Regeneration this round where X is half its Attack.
10226.lore: The All Seeing One anointed this hammer, giving its wielder the strength to bolster their allies and crush their enemies. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10230.name: Ristul Emblem
10230.text: Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +4 [g:510[Health]] and -2 [g:504[Armor]]. The [g:607[unit]] blocking equipped [g:0[hero]] has -2 [g:504[Armor]].
10230.text_plain: Equipped hero has +4 Health and -2 Armor. The unit blocking equipped hero has -2 Armor.
10230.lore: To those willing to step into a world of Demonic etiquette and politics, the Court of Ristul is willing to offer considerable power... for a price. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10231.name: Cloak of Endless Carnage
10231.text: Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +8 [g:510[Health]]. Draw a card after an [g:601[allied neighbor]] of equipped [g:0[hero]] dies.
10231.text_plain: Equipped hero has +8 Health. Draw a card after an allied neighbor of equipped hero dies.
10231.lore: Nestled in the Fields of Endless Carnage lies the city of Quoidge. An undead metropolis where slovenly butchers rub shoulders with the most proper of corpses. To the living, this cloak is grotesque. To dead, it's the height of fashion. — Jolixia, The Card Faun
effects: Draw a card after an [g:601[allied neighbor]] of equipped [g:0[hero]] dies.

10232.name: Seraphim Shield
10232.text_plain: Equipped hero has +2 Armor. All units have -2 Attack.
10232.lore: Conflict is not for everyone. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10234.name: Poaching Knife
10234.text: Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +2 [g:509[Attack]]. Get 5 gold after an enemy [g:0[hero]] dies. Get 1 gold after an enemy [g:1[creep]] dies.
10234.text_plain: Equipped hero has +2 Attack. Get 5 gold after an enemy hero dies. Get 1 gold after an enemy creep dies.
10234.lore: A Marrowfell Hunter's skinning knife is one of their most prized possession. Made during a centaur coming-of-age ritual, each knife is unique to its wielder, and each one tells a specific story. — Jolixia, The Card Faun
effects: Get 1 gold after an enemy [g:1[creep]] dies.

10235.name: Book of the Dead
10235.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +4 [g:510[Health]]. Add a charge to {s:thisCardName} after an allied [[Melee Creep]] dies.

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] [g:409[Summon]] a [[Zombie]] for each charge and remove all charges.]]
10235.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +4 Health. Add a charge to Book of the Dead after an allied Melee Creep dies.

Active 2: Summon a Zombie for each charge and remove all charges.
10235.lore: Vanessa wanted to take it to the Burnt Hall. Pierpont wanted it safely locked away with the Sapphire Conclave. It was the Crystal Maiden who suggested that they leave it with Auroth... reluctantly, they agreed. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10236.name: Hero's Cape
10236.lore: Some heroes have a greater flair for the dramatic than others... — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10237.name: Platemail
10237.lore: It's not magical, but it is effective. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10238.name: Claymore
10238.lore: You can kill a whole lotta people with this thing. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10241.name: Claszureme Hourglass
10241.text: Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +4 [g:510[Health]]. Whenever opponent draws a card, give that card +1 [g:407[Lock]] if equipped [g:0[hero]] is in any lane.
10241.text_plain: Equipped hero has +4 Health. Whenever opponent draws a card, give that card +1 Lock if equipped hero is in any lane.
10241.lore: It was Pierpont who helped broker the Claszureme Treaty, ensuring that Faceless Void would not wreak havoc with our time stream. In exchange, the Sapphire Conclave agreed to enforce a strict crackdown on Chronomancy. Most hourglasses on this plane were confiscated, but every now and again one turns up... usually in the possession of a wizard too foolish to understand the consequences of his actions — Jolixia, The Card Faun
effects: Whenever opponent draws a card, give that card +1 [g:407[Lock]] if equipped [g:0[hero]] is in any lane.

10242.name: Shield of Basilius
10242.text_plain: Equipped hero has +2 Armor. Equipped hero's allied neighbors have +1 Armor.
10242.lore: The rivalry between Aquila and Basilius is often dramatized by bards throughout the world... but with so many renditions covering all manner of points of view, it's become almost impossible to tell what is fact and what is fiction. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10243.name: Shield of Aquila
10243.text_plain: Equipped hero has +2 Armor. Equipped hero's allied neighbors have +3 Armor.
10243.lore: Aquila is long since dead, but there are those who still seek out items of the famed warlord. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10248.name: Shiva's Guard
10248.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +2 [g:504[Armor]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] [g:401[Modify]] a [g:607[unit]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] with -2 [g:509[Attack]].]]
10248.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +2 Armor.

Active 2: Modify a unit and its allied neighbors with -2 Attack.
10248.lore: If the Seraphim Shield is a hammer, Shiva’s Guard is a scalpel — and when wielded properly can hobble the mightiest of armies. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10252.name: Stonehall Pike
10252.text: Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +2 [g:509[Attack]]. [g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with "Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +1 [g:509[Attack]]" [g:202[after the combat phase]].
10252.text_plain: Equipped hero has +2 Attack. Modify Stonehall Pike with "Equipped hero has +1 Attack" after the combat phase.
10252.lore: The Bronze Legion's hallmark is discipline... not a day goes by where its soldiers aren't training to be the best. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10253.name: Stonehall Plate
10253.text: Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +1 [g:504[Armor]]. [g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with "Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +1 [g:504[Armor]]" [g:202[after the combat phase]].
10253.text_plain: Equipped hero has +1 Armor. Modify Stonehall Plate with "Equipped hero has +1 Armor" after the combat phase.
10253.lore: The forges of Stonehall blacksmiths burn day and night, fueling Emperor Galanius' war machine. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10255.name: Shop Deed
10255.text: Each [g:5[item]] in your Secret Shop costs X less gold, where X is equal to its base cost.
10255.text_plain: Each item in your Secret Shop costs X less gold, where X is equal to its base cost.
10255.lore: Welcome to the wonderful world of commerce. — Jolixia, The Card Faun
effects: Each [g:5[item]] in your Secret Shop costs X less gold, where X is equal to its base cost.

10256.name: Jasper Daggers
10256.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +2 [g:509[Attack]] and [g:611[Pierce]].

[color:equip_effect[Equip Effect:]] [g:402[Purge]] your opponent's effects from equipped [g:0[hero]].
10256.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +2 Attack and Pierce.

Equip Effect: Purge your opponent's effects from equipped hero.
10256.lore: Many characterise the Jasper Circle as a group of assassins for hire... this is a crude oversimplification. Lorlin Lasan's spy ring offers many services to those who can afford them, murder just happens to be the most popular. — Jolixia, The Card Faun
effects: [color:equip_effect[Equip Effect:]] [g:402[Purge]] your opponent's effects from equipped [g:0[hero]].

10259.name: Keenfolk Plate
10259.text: Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +1 [g:504[Armor]]. Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +1 [g:504[Armor]] for each of its attackers. Equipped [g:0[hero]]'s attackers have -1 [g:504[Armor]].
10259.text_plain: Equipped hero has +1 Armor. Equipped hero has +1 Armor for each of its attackers. Equipped hero's attackers have -1 Armor.
10259.lore: The...'unique' personality of many Keenfolk lead to the development of armor that could respond to the number of people trying to beat them up. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10260.name: Horn of the Alpha
10260.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +4 Health.

Active 2: Summon a Thunderhide Pack.
10260.lore: Every year, a group of centaurs from the Marrowfell Tribe are chosen to go on 'The Great Hunt'. The goal of this expedition is to test the skill and endurance of the tribe's finest trackers. To these men and women, there is no glory greater than claiming the horn of a Thunderhide Alpha for their own. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10262.name: Nyctasha's Guard
10262.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +1 [g:504[Armor]].

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] Move equipped [g:0[hero]]'s [g:600[enemy neighbors]] to random other lanes.]]
10262.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +1 Armor.

Active 1: Move equipped hero's enemy neighbors to random other lanes.
10262.lore: Legend has it that the God of Fear herself forged this shield, and that no enemy of its wielder can dare to stand its presence. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10263.name: Apotheosis Blade
10263.text:
Equipped [g:0[hero]] has +8 [g:509[Attack]] and +4 [g:501[Siege]]. [g:408[Condemn]] each [g:607[unit]] equipped [g:0[hero]] deals [g:609[battle damage]] to.

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] [g:408[Condemn]] enemy [g:3[improvements]]. [g:408[Condemn]] each [g:5[item]] equipped by the [g:607[unit]] blocking equipped [g:0[hero]].]]
10263.text_plain:
Equipped hero has +8 Attack and +4 Siege. Condemn each unit equipped hero deals battle damage to.

Active 1: Condemn enemy improvements. Condemn each item equipped by the unit blocking equipped hero.
10263.lore: Long ago, the Apotheosis Blade was forged with a singular and wicked purpose: to let the wielder kill a god and assume its power. Today, it is but one of many accursed artifacts safely tucked away inside the Burnt Hall of Weeping Rose. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10267.name: Astral Imprisonment
10267.text: [g:405[Stun]] a [g:607[unit]] this round. Give that [g:607[unit]] [g:507[Damage Immunity]] this round.
10267.text_plain: Stun a unit this round. Give that unit Damage Immunity this round.
10267.lore: For me, the void is a place of reflection and peace... but to my enemies, it is a realm of inscrutable horror. — Outworld Devourer, Master of the Void

10268.name: Lodestone Demolition
10268.text: Deal damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] equal to the total [g:504[Armor]] on enemies.
10268.text_plain: Deal damage to the enemy tower equal to the total Armor on enemies.
10268.lore: The temporary battlements the Bronze Legion erected in Roseleaf aren't particularly well constructed and lodestone is dreadfully magnetic. We should be able to pull Tresdin's soldiers right through her own defenses. — Lorlin Lasan, Saboteur

10270.name: Grazing Shot
10270.text: Deal 2 damage to a [g:607[unit]] in any lane.
10270.text_plain: Deal 2 damage to a unit in any lane.
10270.lore: Listen I'm not saying Windranger is a bad shot, I'm saying she's an aggressively mediocre shot. — Drow Ranger, Not-So-Friendly Rival

10272.name: Assassinate
10272.text: Deal 10 [g:508[piercing]] damage to a [g:607[unit]] in any lane.
10272.text_plain: Deal 10 piercing damage to a unit in any lane.
10272.lore: Don't get me wrong I'm impressed with what these young Keen are able to dream up, but lasers and robots take away the artistry of killing a man. In my day you had to have skill and patience to assassinate someone at range. Now they just set off an explosion. — Sniper reminisces about the good old days

10273.name: Hip Fire
10273.text:
Deal 4 damage to a [g:607[unit]].

[color:quick[[g:604[▢ Get initiative]].]]
10273.text_plain:
Deal 4 damage to a unit.

Get initiative.
10273.lore: I may be old, but my reflexes are as sharp as ever. Unless I skipped my nap, in which case my reflexes are significantly less sharp. — Sniper, Oldie But A Goodie

10274.name: Heartstopper Aura
10274.text: [g:401[Modify]] a [color:black[black [g:0[hero]]]] with "Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to this [g:0[hero]]'s [g:600[enemy neighbors]] [g:200[before the action phase]]."
10274.text_plain: Modify a black hero with "Deal 2 piercing damage to this hero's enemy neighbors before the action phase."
10274.lore: The weak are not worthy to be culled by my blade. — Necrophos, Sadist
effects: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to this [g:0[hero]]'s [g:600[enemy neighbors]] [g:200[before the action phase]].
modifications: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to this [g:0[hero]]'s [g:600[enemy neighbors]] [g:200[before the action phase]].

10275.name: Mana Drain
10275.text: Give the enemy [g:2[tower]] -2 [g:511[Mana]] this round and give your [g:2[tower]] +2 [g:511[Mana]] this round.
10275.text_plain: Give the enemy tower -2 Mana this round and give your tower +2 Mana this round.
10275.lore: The demon's hand grants me not just the ability to snuff out life. But to consume their very essence. — Lion, Mage Bane

10277.name: Frostbite
10277.text: Deal 2 damage to a [g:607[unit]] and [g:404[disarm]] it this round.
10277.text_plain: Deal 2 damage to a unit and disarm it this round.
10277.lore: Unlike Lina, I like to try to find solutions that don't involve killing everyone. — Crystal Maiden, Less Destructive Sister

10278.name: Thundergod's Wrath
10278.text: Deal 4 [g:508[piercing]] damage to each enemy [g:0[hero]] in all lanes.
10278.text_plain: Deal 4 piercing damage to each enemy hero in all lanes.
10278.lore: The full brunt of my fury is something beautiful and terrible to behold. — Zeus, Angry God

10280.name: Empower
10280.text_plain: Modify a unit with +3 Attack and +3 Cleave.
10280.lore: The strength of my people lives in me... and I will use it to find those who hunt my kin. — Magnus, Proud Magnoceros

10281.name: Ion Shell
10281.lore: A thug knows only how to swing a sword... he gives no thought into the consequences... this predictable behavior is easily exploited. — Dark Seer, Master Tactician

10282.name: Enrage
10282.text_plain: Give a red hero +4 Attack and +4 Armor this round.
10282.lore: When you see one of my people fight, it is not just a body on a battlefield. Each of us is joined by the spirits of our ancestors, and it's their strength that fuels us... — Ursa, Guided By His Ancestors

10287.name: Aphotic Shield
10287.text: [g:402[Purge]] your opponent's effects from a [g:607[unit]]. Give that [g:607[unit]] +2 [g:504[Armor]] and +2 [g:503[Retaliate]] this round.
10287.text_plain: Purge your opponent's effects from a unit. Give that unit +2 Armor and +2 Retaliate this round.
10287.lore: Those with the gall to strike at the Lord of Avernus will pay for their transgressions. — Abaddon, Imbued By The Mist

10288.name: Berserker's Call
10288.text: Choose an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]]. It battles its [g:600[enemy neighbors]].
10288.text_plain: Choose an allied red hero. It battles its enemy neighbors.
10288.lore: Axe doesn't look back on his time in the Red Mist with particular fondness, but he acknowledges that he learned a lot about violence. — Axe, Former Khan of the Red Mist

10289.name: Blood Rage
10289.text: [g:406[Silence]] a [g:607[unit]] this round. Give that [g:607[unit]] +4 [g:509[Attack]] this round.
10289.text_plain: Silence a unit this round. Give that unit +4 Attack this round.
10289.lore: My role is a sacred one. The holy blades and armor I wield allows me to be a conduit to the Flayed Ones... and the blood I spill in combat becomes tribute, given in the name of my people. — Bloodseeker, Servant of the Flayed Ones

10290.name: Kraken Shell
10290.text_plain:
Modify a red hero with +1 Armor.

Get initiative.
10290.lore: Don't call it a backpack. — Tidehunter, In Denial

10291.name: March of the Machines
10291.text: [g:200[Before the action phase]], if there are charges on {s:thisCardName}, remove one and deal 2 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] and 2 damage to each enemy.
10291.text_plain: Before the action phase, if there are charges on March of the Machines, remove one and deal 2 damage to the enemy tower and 2 damage to each enemy.
10291.lore: Every Keenfolk has a pet obsession. Sniper likes shooting things. Timbersaw cuts down trees. I develop fun and exciting ways to kill Mazzie. Some might frown at my attempted murder, but if I never developed these drones, he never would have built his robot suit to hide in. So really, he should be thanking me. — Tinker, No Friend Of Mazzie
effects: [g:200[Before the action phase]], if there are charges on {s:thisCardName}, remove one and deal 2 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] and 2 damage to each enemy.

10292.name: Double Edge
10292.text_plain: Give a red hero +8 Attack and -8 Armor this round.
10292.lore: In battle, as in life; there are moments where you are forced to choose between greatness and security. — Warrunner, Fearless Warrior

10293.name: Primal Roar
10293.text: [g:405[Stun]] a [g:607[unit]] blocking an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]] this round. Move that [g:607[unit]]'s [g:601[allied neighbors]] to random other lanes.
10293.text_plain: Stun a unit blocking an allied red hero this round. Move that unit's allied neighbors to random other lanes.
10293.lore: I've seen many hunters in my day. Each one bold. And strong. And fearless. Fearless that is, until they realize they're not the Apex Predator... and then they run like the cowards they are.— Beastmaster, Apex Predator

10294.name: Viper Strike
10294.text: Give a [g:607[unit]] "Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to this [g:607[unit]] [g:200[before the action phase]]" until it dies.
10294.text_plain: Give a unit "Deal 2 piercing damage to this unit before the action phase" until it dies.
10294.lore: In time, all things will die... I just like to do my part to speed up the process. — Viper, Lethal Fangs
effects: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to this [g:607[unit]] [g:200[before the action phase]].
modifications: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to this [g:607[unit]] [g:200[before the action phase]].

10295.name: Arcane Censure
10295.text_plain: Modify the enemy tower with -1 Mana.
10295.lore: Many different types of wizards fall under my care in the Tyler Estate. I do not bother to learn their stories or their crimes... if the Quorum has sent them to me they are to be treated in the same manner. Harshly. — Silencer, Warden of the Tyler Estate

10296.name: Whirling Death
10296.text: Choose an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]]. Deal 2 damage to its [g:600[enemy neighbors]] and give them -2 [g:509[Attack]] this round.
10296.text_plain: Choose an allied red hero. Deal 2 damage to its enemy neighbors and give them -2 Attack this round.
10296.lore: I was nervous about following the Society of Likeminded Keenfolk to Roseleaf... Sniper had a lot of rules. Rules like 'we can't stop to cut down every tree'. But when he saw the Treants marching towards us, he quickly made an exception. — Timbersaw, Crazed Lumberjack

10297.name: Defensive Stance
10297.text_plain: Give a hero +3 Armor this round.
10297.lore: Sometimes people ask me 'Mazzie, how do you keep from getting killed if everyone hates you?' And that's when I tell them 'The secret is not letting them stab you to death.' — Mazzie, Full of Good Advice

10298.name: Lost in Time
10298.text: Give three random cards in opponent's hand +3 [g:407[Lock]].
10298.text_plain: Give three random cards in opponent's hand +3 Lock.
10298.lore: In Claszureme, time is like water... nourishing, beautiful to behold in its various forms... and endlessly fun to play in. — Faceless Void, Shaper of Time

10299.name: Defend the Weak
10299.text_plain: Modify a unit with "This unit's allied neighbors have +2 Armor."
10299.lore: Ilexa has no idea how important she will be in the days to come. She must be protected at all costs. — Magnus to the Prowlers

10300.name: Combat Training
10300.lore: The ability to successfully kill someone that wants to kill you is a life skill everyone should have. Even Goodkind. — Axe, Proud Teacher

10302.name: Self Sabotage
10302.text: [g:401[Modify]] two random cards in opponent's hand with "[g:608[□]] Deal 6 damage to a random allied [g:2[tower]] in any lane."
10302.text_plain: Modify two random cards in opponent's hand with " Deal 6 damage to a random allied tower in any lane."
10302.lore: I wouldn't go so far as to say that there are some places that even the Jasper Circle can't reach, just that sometimes courting betrayal is significantly easier. — Lorlin Lasan, Problem Solver
modifications: [g:608[□]] Deal 6 damage to a random allied [g:2[tower]] in any lane.

10303.name: Bellow
10303.text: Move a [g:1[creep]] to a random other lane.
10303.text_plain: Move a creep to a random other lane.
10303.lore: It's the rule of nature: there is always something stronger and deadlier than you. Some people need to be reminded of that truth. — Magnus on Jungle Survival

10305.name: Raze
10305.lore: Sometimes I think Sniper doesn't really want to be my friend, he just wants me on his side so I won't destroy everything he loves. — Timbersaw, Paranoid Keen

10306.name: Smash Their Defenses!
10306.text_plain: Condemn an improvement. Draw a card.
10306.lore: Everyone likes to think they build things that last, but if you give the Keen enough time, we'll figure out how to destroy anything. — Timbersaw, Founding Member of the S.O.L.K.

10307.name: Foresight
10307.lore: The Oracle claims to see every eventuality; if true such a man could be a powerful ally... or at the very least a foe worth testing myself against. — Dark Seer ponders the future

10308.name: Coup de Grace
10308.text_plain: Discard a random card. Condemn a hero.
10308.lore: I'm immoral, not a sadist. If I am asked to kill you it will be clean and quick. — Phantom Assassin, Efficient Killer

10310.name: Oglodi Catapult
10310.text: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] [g:200[before the action phase]].
10310.text_plain: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower before the action phase.
10310.lore: The Bronze Legion weren't supposed be in Roseleaf, but it doesn't matter... we were going to have to face them eventually. On one hand it's a shame. A warrior like Tresdin deserves more than dying in some backwater vhoul city. On the other, perhaps it is a mercy that she will be spared from seeing her beloved city burn. — Vreth, Oglodi Artillerist
effects: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] [g:200[before the action phase]].

10311.name: Arm the Rebellion
10311.text_plain: Modify allied creeps with +2 Attack and +1 Armor.
10311.lore: I'll never forget the first day of the rebellion. Tresdin sent me to collect rations from the farmers of Roseleaf... supplies in case the Red Mist siege would be prolonged... but it was a lean year for those farmers. I reported what they could spare, but Tresdin decided it wasn't enough, and so she instructed her thugs to take what they needed by force...after all, 'it was for their own good.' Well when her people arrived they didn't find cowering farmers. They found an army that I will lead until my dying day. The men, women and pups of Roseleaf deserve to live their lives free of Stonehall's grip. And while the price of their freedom will be blood, it is a price we are all willing to pay. — Rix, Rabble-Rouser

10312.name: Strafing Run
10312.text_plain: Deal 2 damage to each enemy creep.
10312.lore: Soaring through the air is not just a liberating experience, it is also an effective way to dispatch one's enemies. — Skywrath Mage, Flying Free

10313.name: Poised to Strike
10313.text_plain: Give a red hero +4 Attack this round.
10313.lore: Courage is not what makes a hunter great. It's patience. — Warrunner speaks to the hunters of Marrowfell

10314.name: Dirty Deeds
10314.text: Deal 2 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] for each of its [g:3[improvements]].
10314.text_plain: Deal 2 damage to the enemy tower for each of its improvements.
10314.lore: Slark and I go back a long time. He's a bastard, but he's my kind of bastard. — Lorlin Lasan, Morally Flexible

10315.name: Annihilation
10315.lore: It is wise to fear the power of the Ancients... — Kanna, Seeker of Matricide

10316.name: Spot Weakness
10316.text: Give a [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] [g:611[Pierce]] this round. Draw a card.
10316.text_plain: Give a hero and its allied neighbors Pierce this round. Draw a card.
10316.lore: Anything is killable. The only question is if you can live long enough to spot its weakness. — Warrunner speaks to the hunters of Marrowfell

10317.name: Curse of Atrophy
10317.lore: Scree'auk has given me the power to exact my revenge... and it will be slow and agonizing. — Shendelzare, the Vengeful Spirit

10318.name: Chain Frost
10318.text:
Deal 3 damage to a [g:607[unit]]. Repeat 7 times: [g:608[□]] Deal 3 damage to a random [g:607[unit]] to its left or right.

[color:quick[[g:604[▢ Get initiative]].]]
10318.text_plain:
Deal 3 damage to a unit. Repeat 7 times: Deal 3 damage to a random unit to its left or right.

Get initiative.
10318.lore: Could I simply cast out a wave of frost? Certainly. But flash freezing your enemies isn't nearly as satisfying as watching them panic before their impending death. — Lich on savoring the moment

10319.name: Diabolic Revelation
10319.text: Draw 2 cards. Deal 2 damage to allies in all lanes.
10319.text_plain: Draw 2 cards. Deal 2 damage to allies in all lanes.
10319.lore: My mother speaks of the Ancients desires. Order. Peace. Devotion. But she's wrong. The ancients demand one thing, and that's blood. — Kanna, Daughter of Prellex

10322.name: Payday
10322.lore: Revtel is my favorite place to do business. The morals are lose, but their contracts are fair; whenever I took a job from The Brass Herald, Lord Sunbreeze, or Kwerthias I knew they'd make good. Kwerthias... ya know, as a general rule you don't make too many friends in my line of work but... he was one of the good ones. I'm sorry he's dead. — in which Gondar remembers a fallen friend

10323.name: Echo Slam
10323.text: Deal damage to each enemy equal to the number of enemies.
10323.text_plain: Deal damage to each enemy equal to the number of enemies.
10323.lore: Prellex is raising an army to destroy her daughter, but I won't allow that to happen. Let them come in droves... no one will get past me. — Earthshaker, Protector of Kanna

10324.name: Iron Branch Protection
10324.text: Give a [g:607[unit]] in any lane +3 [g:504[Armor]] until end of its next [g:203[combat phase]].
10324.text_plain: Give a unit in any lane +3 Armor until end of its next combat phase.
10324.lore: I remember when the Vhoul first made their home in roseleaf. At the time they were not much more than feral beasts, barely worth the treants notice. But as the generations came and went, my cousins became fascinated as they watched a culture grow before their very eyes so when the Vhoul named their city after my cousins as a sign of respect, well... that fascination turned into a sort of love. And so while the Treants of roseleaf try not to directly interfere with the goings on of the Vhoul, they always try to help from afar. — Treant Protector, Branches of Iron

10325.name: Prey on the Weak
10325.text: [g:409[Summon]] a [[Hound of War]] for every damaged [g:607[unit]].
10325.text_plain: Summon a Hound of War for every damaged unit.
10325.lore: There's something particularly satisfying about watching Radiant zealots run for their lives. — Kanna, The Cruelty of Youth

10326.name: Enough Magic!
10326.lore: Axe doesn't know much about magic except that you have to punch it. — Axe, Fan of Simple Solutions

10327.name: Heroic Resolve
10327.text: [g:401[Modify]] a [color:red[red [g:0[hero]]]] with "After you play a non-[g:5[item]] card costing 2 or less, [g:401[modify]] this [g:0[hero]] with +2 [g:510[Health]]."
10327.text_plain: Modify a red hero with "After you play a non-item card costing 2 or less, modify this hero with +2 Health."
10327.lore: The world is a like a 280 lbs belligerent walrus man... it's not just gonna try to beat you down, it's gonna try to beat you while you're down. So when that metaphorical, or in my case very literal, walrus man starts stalkin' towards ya... you only got one option: pick yourself up and punch that bastard in the face. — Bristleback, 5 Pint Philosopher
effects: After you play a non-[g:5[item]] card costing 2 or less, [g:401[modify]] this [g:0[hero]] with +2 [g:510[Health]].
modifications: After you play a non-[g:5[item]] card costing 2 or less, [g:401[modify]] this [g:0[hero]] with +2 [g:510[Health]].

10328.name: Gank
10328.text: Choose an [color:black[allied black [g:0[hero]]]]. Choose another [g:607[unit]] in any lane. They [g:400[battle]] each other.
10328.text_plain: Choose an allied black hero. Choose another unit in any lane. They battle each other.
10328.lore: If you want someone dead, Slark is a wonderful gentleman to know. — Lorlin Lasan, Kobold Spymaster

10330.name: God's Strength
10330.text_plain: Modify a red hero with +4 Attack.
10330.lore: I am not yet strong enough to avenge my father's execution. But in time... I will be. — Sven, Preparing for Vengeance

10331.name: Wrath of Gold
10331.text: Spend all your gold. Repeat one time for each gold spent: [g:608[□]] Deal 4 damage to a random ally or enemy.
10331.text_plain: Spend all your gold. Repeat one time for each gold spent: Deal 4 damage to a random ally or enemy.
10331.lore: The coin of man is useless to me, but instrumental in their own undoing. — in which Outworld Devourer decides to take things literally

10332.name: Murder Plot
10332.text: Give a [color:black[black [g:0[hero]]]] +8 [g:509[Attack]] this round. Choose a combat target for it.
10332.text_plain: Give a black hero +8 Attack this round. Choose a combat target for it.
10332.lore: My task in Revtel has set many events into motion. A new Merchant King will rise to stand alongside Sunbreeze and the Brass Herald. The Relic Slayer has grown bolder in Iron Fog... and the Veiled Sisterhood is now at war with Revtel... but all of this was seen by the Veiled Oracles and all is as it needs to be. — Phantom Assassin, Kingslayer

10334.name: Stars Align
10334.text_plain: Give your tower +3 Mana this round.
10334.lore: Weeping Rose is shrouded in perpetual nightfall, a means for the Quorum to harness the power of the stars. — Silencer welcomes a visitor to Weeping Rose

10335.name: Call the Reserves
10335.text_plain: Summon two Melee Creeps into any lane.
10335.lore: There is no place to hide from the wrath of the Dire. — Kanna, Vengeful Daughter

10336.name: Better Late Than Never
10336.text_plain: Summon a Melee Creep into any lane.
10336.lore: Prellex's army grows larger by the day. For now they're disorganized, but I know my mother. It won't take long before they're a threat. — Kanna strategizes with her allies

10338.name: Divine Intervention
10338.text_plain: Give allies Damage Immunity this round.
10338.lore: The Allseeing one will never forsake His agents. — Omniknight, Soldier of the Divine

10339.name: Gust
10339.text: [g:406[Silence]] an enemy [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] this round.
10339.text_plain: Silence an enemy hero and its allied neighbors this round.
10339.lore: Never take victory for granted... the moment you assume there's nothing an enemy can do to stop you, is the moment you're most likely to lose.— Drow Ranger, Spoiler

10340.name: Hand of God
10340.text: Fully heal each ally. Give allies [g:507[Damage Immunity]] this round.
10340.text_plain: Fully heal each ally. Give allies Damage Immunity this round.
10340.lore: The Knights of the Fold gave me a fresh start and a new life. It will do the same for you was well. — Chen, Converter of Many

10341.name: Duel
10341.text: Choose an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]] and another [g:607[unit]]. They [g:400[battle]] each other.
10341.text_plain: Choose an allied red hero and another unit. They battle each other.
10341.lore: How many more of our people need to die? Let's just end this here and now. — Legion Commander, The battle of Roseleaf

10342.name: Pick a Fight
10342.text: Choose an allied [g:0[hero]]. It [g:403[taunts]]. Choose a combat target for it.
10342.text_plain: Choose an allied hero. It taunts. Choose a combat target for it.
10342.lore: It takes a lot to get me mad- ok that's a lie, I'm always mad. It takes a lot to make me wanna fight someone- yeah, that's not true either. I- oh to hell with it, let's be honest I like punching people. — Bristleback, Lover of Violence

10344.name: Clear the Deck
10344.text_plain: Give allied heroes +4 Cleave this round.
10344.lore: Kunkka can hide on his boat all he likes... it won't be enough to save him. — Tidehunter, Kunkka's Rival

10347.name: Defensive Bloom
10347.lore: I protect the forest, and in turn the forest protects me. — Enchantress, Soul of Spring

10348.name: Allseeing One's Favor
10348.text_plain: Modify a green hero with "Allies have +2 Regeneration."
10348.lore: Once I doubted my faith; but no longer. The All Seeing one has chosen me to be its champion and I will not let the Omniscience down. — Omniknight, Rewarded For His Faith

10349.name: Rising Anger
10349.text: [g:401[Modify]] a [color:red[red [g:0[hero]]]] with "After you play a non-[g:5[item]] card costing 2 or less, [g:401[modify]] this [g:0[hero]] with +1 [g:509[Attack]]."
10349.text_plain: Modify a red hero with "After you play a non-item card costing 2 or less, modify this hero with +1 Attack."
10349.lore: Tusk's breath was a mix of stale beer and raw fish, but I wasn't about to back down... no... I was just getting started. — Bristleback, No Quit In Him
effects: After you play a non-[g:5[item]] card costing 2 or less, [g:401[modify]] this [g:0[hero]] with +1 [g:509[Attack]].
modifications: After you play a non-[g:5[item]] card costing 2 or less, [g:401[modify]] this [g:0[hero]] with +1 [g:509[Attack]].

10350.name: Sucker Punch
10350.text: [g:405[Stun]] a [g:607[unit]] blocking an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]] this round. Deal 2 damage to that [g:607[unit]].
10350.text_plain: Stun a unit blocking an allied red hero this round. Deal 2 damage to that unit.
10350.lore: There are few things more annoying than fighting a cat man that makes copies of himself. Every time you think you kill the last one, there’s always another one behind you. — Axe, Easily Fooled

10352.name: Lightning Strike
10352.text_plain: Deal 6 damage to the enemy tower.
10352.lore: Be grateful you only annoyed me mortal, had you offended me the results would be far more... interesting. — Zeus, 'Merciful' God

10353.name: Bolt of Damocles
10353.text_plain: Deal 20 damage to the enemy tower.
10353.lore: Some mistake my taking on the mortal coil as a sign that I have grown weaker. Every now and again I like to remind the world that that isn't the case. My wife would say that cratering a city is overkill. She's probably right. But I've always been a fan of grand gestures. — Zeus, Poor Impulse Control

10354.name: Pick Off
10354.text: Deal 4 damage to a [g:607[unit]] in any lane.
10354.text_plain: Deal 4 damage to a unit in any lane.
10354.lore: If I'm to survive long enough to make it to Weeping Rose, I need to stay vigilant... and remove any threats before they could possibly harm me. — Lion, Asylum Seeker

10355.name: Dimensional Portal
10355.lore: It doesn't matter where the battle rages... the Radiant will always stand up to the horrors the Dire bring. — Prellex, Committed to her Cause

10358.name: Restoration Effort
10358.lore: Eventually the war will be over and the armies will scatter, but that's when the real work will begin. — Enchantress, Bringer of Hope

10359.name: Buying Time
10359.text: Give two random cards in opponent's hand +2 [g:407[Lock]].
10359.text_plain: Give two random cards in opponent's hand +2 Lock.
10359.lore: Pierpont and I don’t agree on a lot of things, but he was wise to recognize the dangers of angering The Faceless Void. I'm not super wild about the Claszureme Treaty, Chronomancy was a lot of fun. But you know what's also fun? Not having your timeline obliterated. — Vanessa opines on the Claszureme Treaty

10360.name: Friendly Fire
10360.text: Choose two enemies. They [g:400[battle]] each other.
10360.text_plain: Choose two enemies. They battle each other.
10360.lore: Friends always let you down. — Drow Ranger, Force Unto Herself

10361.name: Coordinated Assault
10361.text: [g:401[Modify]] a [color:black[black [g:0[hero]]]] with "After you play a [color:black[black card]], give this [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] +2 [g:509[Attack]] this round."
10361.text_plain: Modify a black hero with "After you play a black card, give this hero and its allied neighbors +2 Attack this round."
10361.lore: I don't understand why the veiled sisterhood decided to provoke a war with Revtel, but it is a fight they will regret starting. — The Brass Herald, Monster in Mourning
effects: After you play a [color:black[black card]], give this [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] +2 [g:509[Attack]] this round.
modifications: After you play a [color:black[black card]], give this [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] +2 [g:509[Attack]] this round.

10365.name: Juke
10365.text: Swap an ally with one of its [g:601[allied neighbors]].
10365.text_plain: Swap an ally with one of its allied neighbors.
10365.lore: I've lived a long as I have because I always stay mobile... — Drow Ranger, On The Move

10366.name: New Orders
10366.text: Choose an ally. Choose a combat target for it.
10366.text_plain: Choose an ally. Choose a combat target for it.
10366.lore: Armies lose battles when their generals are unable to adapt to the situation. — Legion Commander on maintaining poise

10367.name: Rend Armor
10367.text: [g:401[Modify]] a [g:607[unit]] with -X [g:504[Armor]] where X is its [g:504[Armor]].
10367.text_plain: Modify a unit with -X Armor where X is its Armor.
10367.lore: The keen believe that their soulless contraptions give them an edge in battle, but I will show them that their 'sci-ance' is not strong enough. — Ursa, Armor's Bane

10368.name: Avernus' Blessing
10368.lore: If Abaddon isn't willing to share the mist of Avernus, I'll just have to find a way to take it — Traxex on her quest for power

10370.name: Fight Through the Pain
10370.text:
Give a [color:red[red [g:0[hero]]]] +2 [g:504[Armor]] this round.

[color:quick[[g:604[▢ Get initiative]].]]
10370.text_plain:
Give a red hero +2 Armor this round.

Get initiative.
10370.lore: I've seen a lot of people try to kill Axe over the years. 3 of them even got close. — Goodkind, Bard to Axe

10373.name: Soul of Spring
10373.text: [g:401[Modify]] a [g:0[hero]] with "After you play a [color:green[green card]], give this [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] +4 [g:505[Regeneration]] this round."
10373.text_plain: Modify a hero with "After you play a green card, give this hero and its allied neighbors +4 Regeneration this round."
10373.lore: Hope never dies, it just goes dormant... and when the conditions are right, it can be reborn anew. — Enchantress, on the destruction of Roseleaf
effects: After you play a [color:green[green card]], give this [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] +4 [g:505[Regeneration]] this round.
modifications: After you play a [color:green[green card]], give this [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] +4 [g:505[Regeneration]] this round.

10374.name: Arcane Assault
10374.text:
Deal 2 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]]. Draw a card.

[color:quick[[g:604[▢ Get initiative]].]]
10374.text_plain:
Deal 2 damage to the enemy tower. Draw a card.

Get initiative.
10374.lore: Rubick claims to be Aghanim's son. I'm not sure I believe it, but I certainly wouldn't say that to Rubick's face. — Vanessa, Opinionated Occultist

10376.name: Remote Detonation
10376.text: Deal 5 damage to each enemy across from an empty combat position.
10376.text_plain: Deal 5 damage to each enemy across from an empty combat position.
10376.lore: The purist in me hates how much Techies rely on explosives... but you can't deny they're effective. — Kardel debates the pros and cons of Techies

10377.name: Fog of War
10377.text: Each enemy has a 50% chance of being disarmed this round.
10377.text_plain: Each enemy has a 50% chance of being disarmed this round.
10377.lore: Chronicling Axe's adventure's has taken me to lots of interesting places. It first it was scary but eventually you get used to a certain level of baseline terror. — Goodkind, Axe's Voice of Reason

10378.name: Divine Purpose
10378.text_plain: Modify a unit with Damage Immunity.
10378.lore: My god gave me purpose. A holy mission. Until this geas is completed I will not know defeat. — Omniknight, Man on a Mission

10379.name: Intimidation
10379.text: Move a [g:607[unit]] to a random other lane.
10379.text_plain: Move a unit to a random other lane.
10379.lore: Pugna taught me to savor every delicious moment before the kill. — Viper, Trained by Pugna

10382.name: Cleansing Rite
10382.text_plain: Purge your opponent's effects from a hero.
10382.lore: Healing doesn't end suffering, it merely treats it. The only way to end suffering is to actively fight those who cause it. — Lady Anshu, Rumusque High Priestess

10385.name: Tresdin's Standards
10385.text: [g:401[Modify]] a [color:red[red [g:0[hero]]]] with "After you play a [color:red[red card]], give this [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] +1 [g:509[Attack]] and +1 [g:504[Armor]] this round."
10385.text_plain: Modify a red hero with "After you play a red card, give this hero and its allied neighbors +1 Attack and +1 Armor this round."
10385.lore: Emperor Galanius expects much from me. And I expect the same from those I command. — a quiet moment between Tresdin and Belasanno
effects: After you play a [color:red[red card]], give this [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] +1 [g:509[Attack]] and +1 [g:504[Armor]] this round.
modifications: After you play a [color:red[red card]], give this [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] +1 [g:509[Attack]] and +1 [g:504[Armor]] this round.

10391.name: Compel
10391.text: Choose a [g:607[unit]]. Choose a combat target for it. Draw a card.
10391.text_plain: Choose a unit. Choose a combat target for it. Draw a card.
10391.lore: Some are fit to rule. Most live to obey. — Kanna, Cult of Personality

10396.name: Caught Unprepared
10396.text_plain: Stun a hero until they equip an item.
10396.lore: You don't need a gun, just a drop on the guy who has one. — Traxex, Keenfolk Hunter

10399.name: Relentless Pursuit
10399.text: Choose a [g:607[unit]] in another lane. Move a random [color:black[allied black [g:0[hero]]]] from this lane to that lane. [g:608[□]] Deal 2 damage to the chosen [g:607[unit]].
10399.text_plain: Choose a unit in another lane. Move a random allied black hero from this lane to that lane. Deal 2 damage to the chosen unit.
10399.lore: When The Veiled Sisters set their mind to a pursuit, they are dogged in it. It is a lesson I have learned well. — The Brass Herald, Ruthless Enemy

10402.name: Tower Barrage
10402.lore: Our defenses are strong, but not impenetrable... Fortunately our towers tend to ward off all but the most determined. — Prellex, Defender of the Radiant

10403.name: Steal Strength
10403.text: Give a [g:607[unit]] -4 [g:509[Attack]] this round and give another [g:607[unit]] +4 [g:509[Attack]] this round.
10403.text_plain: Give a unit -4 Attack this round and give another unit +4 Attack this round.
10403.lore: The strong always think they are untouchable. But the look on their faces when they realize they are not, is a joy to behold. — Shendelzare, beloved of Skywrath Mage

10404.name: The Cover of Night
10404.text: Move an [color:black[allied black [g:0[hero]]]] to another lane. Give that [g:0[hero]] +4 [g:509[Attack]] and +7 [g:501[Siege]] until end of its next [g:203[combat phase]].
10404.text_plain: Move an allied black hero to another lane. Give that hero +4 Attack and +7 Siege until end of its next combat phase.

voice_lines.abaddon_kill_rival_09: I fear no death...you on the other hand...
voice_lines.abaddon_permanent_armor_03: I will be a force to be feared.
voice_lines.abaddon_unique_19: Who can stand against this army?!
voice_lines.assassins_apprentice_ancient_both_01: I won't fail in my mission.
voice_lines.assassins_apprentice_hero_friend_02: Its an honor to learn from the best...
voice_lines.beastmaster_arrogant_10: At least I'm honest about my hatred of people.
voice_lines.beastmaster_concerned_03: This requires a delicate hand. I'm bad at delicate things.
voice_lines.beastmaster_enigmatic_03: Its impossible not to be humbled by this place...
voice_lines.bloodseeker_angry_06: You have no idea who you're dealing with...
voice_lines.bloodseeker_arrogant_08: Not an ideal sacrifice, but I'll take what I can get.
voice_lines.bloodseeker_concerned_06: Is this to be my fate...
voice_lines.bloodseeker_single_target_damage_10: Offer your throat and save us all some time...
voice_lines.bounty_hunter_arrogant_06: What did you expect to happen...
voice_lines.bounty_hunter_arrogant_09: There was no way you were going to survive.
voice_lines.bounty_hunter_concerned_05: Why can't I catch a break...
voice_lines.bounty_hunter_multi_damage_small_06: I got a little surprise for you...
voice_lines.bristleback_kill_rival_05: I'm gonna punch your face in.
voice_lines.bristleback_potential_kill_05: At least you made me work for it.
voice_lines.bristleback_unique_05: I could do this all day...
voice_lines.centaur_warrunner_angry_07: When I'm through with you there will be nothing left to bury...
voice_lines.centaur_warrunner_arrogant_05: My clan has no warriors as pathetic as you.
voice_lines.centaur_warrunner_enigmatic_06: There's a way around any problem...
voice_lines.chen_arrogant_02: Once I was like you... pathetic.
voice_lines.chen_concerned_09: This is just another tribulation I must weather...
voice_lines.crystal_maiden_permanent_health_05: It's not blind optimism when you can back it up.
voice_lines.crystal_maiden_unique_06: Well this was inevitable wasn't it.
voice_lines.cursed_satyr_tower_destroy_04: We must hurry and end this!
voice_lines.cursed_satyr_tower_destroy_05: I won't be ruled by fear.
voice_lines.cursed_satyr_tower_saved_03: I want my death to mean something.
voice_lines.dark_seer_permanent_armor_05: It's all part of my plan.
voice_lines.dark_seer_taunt_generic_06: I'm the greatest military mind in generations.
voice_lines.dark_troll_chieften_angry_05: I will not be made a fool of!
voice_lines.dark_troll_chieften_arrogant_10: You were delusional if you thought you would win.
voice_lines.dark_troll_chieften_concerned_07: It's not too late, I can fix this...
voice_lines.disciple_of_nevermore_ancient_both_01: We'll end this once and for all.
voice_lines.disciple_of_nevermore_unique_01: Do I have a deal for you.
voice_lines.drow_ranger_angry_07: That's the last mistake you'll make!
voice_lines.drow_ranger_angry_09: I'm going to take my time with you...
voice_lines.drow_ranger_arrogant_06: I thought there was going to be a challenge...
voice_lines.drow_ranger_concerned_04: This isn't exactly how I planned this going...
voice_lines.drow_ranger_enigmatic_09: Trust me, you're getting off easy.
voice_lines.earthshaker_arrogant_07: There's no shame in admitting you're outmatched...
voice_lines.earthshaker_concerned_04: We can pull this off... I think...
voice_lines.earthshaker_enigmatic_06: You're about to behold something wondrous and terrible...
voice_lines.earthshaker_enigmatic_08: That drum you hear is the sound of your undoing...
voice_lines.emissary_tower_destroy_04: I've come to accelerate the inevitable.
voice_lines.emissary_tower_saved_01: This battle is far from over.
voice_lines.emissary_tower_saved_03: The tide is beginning to turn.
voice_lines.enchantress_arrogant_05: You're not half as clever as you think you are...
voice_lines.enchantress_arrogant_09: You never really had a chance....
voice_lines.enchantress_concerned_10: It's getting hard to stay optimistic...
voice_lines.enchantress_enigmatic_04: Perhaps some good will come of this...
voice_lines.enchantress_pleased_08: I feel like singing, I mean I won't do it, but the sentiment remains...
voice_lines.kanna_angry_08: You're going to beg for me to kill you.
voice_lines.kanna_arrogant_07: Oh the things I will do to you...
voice_lines.kanna_concerned_04: They think they won, but I'll show them...
voice_lines.kanna_concerned_07: How did things spiral out of control...
voice_lines.kanna_enigmatic_03: Once I was weak... no longer.
voice_lines.kanna_enigmatic_08: Your world is about to crumble...
voice_lines.kobold_saboteur_pleased_04: I'm having a great time, are you having a great time?
voice_lines.kobold_saboteur_single_target_damage_02: Watch a professional do her thing.
voice_lines.legion_commander_cast_spell_03: I have you just where I want you.
voice_lines.legion_commander_kill_rival_08: It was over before it began.
voice_lines.legion_commander_kill_rival_09: You can't fight a superior force.
voice_lines.legion_commander_taunt_generic_02: Bend the knee or be destroyed!
voice_lines.lich_angry_06: You will regret ever coming here...
voice_lines.lich_enigmatic_08: I hope you've made peace with your deities…
voice_lines.lion_kill_rival_04: This will be quick, but not painless.
voice_lines.lion_kill_rival_08: You've never faced an enemy like me.
voice_lines.lion_taunt_generic_04: What chance do you have against the demon witch.
voice_lines.lion_unique_06: I can take any life I wish.
voice_lines.luna_cast_spell_09: This war was over before it began.
voice_lines.luna_kill_rival_09: This isn't going well for you, is it?
voice_lines.luna_taunt_generic_08: Don't be cocky, the battle isn't over yet.
voice_lines.luna_unique_20: That's just a taste of what's to come...
voice_lines.lycan_potential_save_05: Better men have tried to kill me...
voice_lines.lycan_unique_07: Now is the time to strike!
voice_lines.magnus_taunt_generic_08: This is the time for glory!
voice_lines.marrowfell_brawler_ancient_attack_02: Our victory will make a fine story...
voice_lines.mazzie_angry_03: I am a person with feelings and words hurt!
voice_lines.mazzie_angry_10: You're making some poor life choices my friend!
voice_lines.mazzie_arrogant_09: Who needs a magic spell when I can just punch you in the face? And by 'me' I mean my robot.
voice_lines.mazzie_arrogant_10: I'm not trying to brag. But Snipers my best friend and he totally hates you.
voice_lines.mazzie_concerned_06: Not gonna lie, when I woke up this morning I didn't think I was going to die.
voice_lines.mazzie_enigmatic_03: This is either gonna be awesome or it's getting everyone killed...
voice_lines.meepo_angry_06: You started it, but I’m gonna finish it...
voice_lines.meepo_arrogant_04: Who's better than me? Don't answer that.
voice_lines.meepo_concerned_04: THIS IS ALL YOUR FAULT MEEPO!
voice_lines.meepo_concerned_08: I have made some poor life choices, haven't I...
voice_lines.meepo_enigmatic_04: This is gonna blow your fragile mind.
voice_lines.meepo_enigmatic_10: Maybe next time you'll take me more seriously....
voice_lines.mercenary_exiles_hero_rival_03: You barbarians don’t have a chance against trained soldiers...
voice_lines.necrophos_arrogant_04: I wish you could see the look on your face...
voice_lines.necrophos_arrogant_08: I was hoping you'd be a challenge. Pity.
voice_lines.necrophos_concerned_03: This isn't going as I planned...
voice_lines.necrophos_concerned_06: I won't let this be the end.
voice_lines.necrophos_pleased_09: Oh such wonderful things I have in store...
voice_lines.ogre_bruiser_angry_05: I will crush your stupid skull.
voice_lines.ogre_bruiser_arrogant_10: I was expecting more from you....
voice_lines.ogre_bruiser_concerned_04: Why do I get the feeling I'm going to die...
voice_lines.ogre_bruiser_enigmatic_06: Slacks loves me. And that's enough.
voice_lines.ogre_corpse_tosser_ancient_both_02: Hope you have lots of friends...
voice_lines.ogre_magi_angry_08: You think you're so smart Not as smart as us!
voice_lines.ogre_magi_arrogant_10: We may not be the strongest. But we're smarterest.
voice_lines.ogre_magi_concerned_06: If we stay calm we can survive this WE'RE GONNA DIE!
voice_lines.ogre_magi_enigmatic_06: Time to get creative... we're throwing a rock? No. Even better...
voice_lines.ogre_magi_enigmatic_10: If you don't think about anything, your enemy can never guess what you're thinking....
voice_lines.ogre_magi_pleased_08: I haven't felt this happy since we first started lighting people on fire...
voice_lines.omniknight_arrogant_10: With the All Seeing One on our side, we cannot lose!
voice_lines.omniknight_concerned_09: The odds are not in our favor...
voice_lines.omniknight_enigmatic_02: Death holds no power over me...
voice_lines.outworld_devourer_angry_08: You shall find neither mercy nor pity.
voice_lines.outworld_devourer_arrogant_01: What hope have you? What foolish, stupid hope?
voice_lines.outworld_devourer_arrogant_04: You actually believe you can still win?
voice_lines.outworld_devourer_concerned_01: I should have seen this coming.
voice_lines.outworld_devourer_concerned_07: With clear eyes, I face the inevitable.
voice_lines.phantom_assassin_cast_spell_06: I don't know why you were chosen, just that you must die.
voice_lines.phantom_assassin_kill_rival_06: No one is beyond my reach.
voice_lines.phantom_assassin_permanent_attack_05: I'm ready for the next name on my list.
voice_lines.phantom_assassin_potential_save_03: You'll have to try better than that...
voice_lines.prellex_cast_spell_05: Bask in the light of the Radiant!
voice_lines.prellex_cast_spell_09: There are many false prophets... I am not one of them.
voice_lines.prellex_kill_rival_09: You are on the wrong side of history.
voice_lines.prellex_permanent_health_03: I will not give in to fear.
voice_lines.prowler_shaman_arrogant_07: I was expecting more from you...
voice_lines.prowler_shaman_concerned_03: I need to find a way to fix this.
voice_lines.prowler_shaman_enigmatic_10: I'm used to being under estimated.
voice_lines.prowler_vanguard_ancient_both_01: I'll give my life if it means victory.
voice_lines.prowler_vanguard_unique_08: I'll buy you as much time as I can.
voice_lines.pugna_angry_01: I HAVE NOT LOST CONTROL! I AM CONTROL!
voice_lines.pugna_angry_03: I'll kill you! Burn you! Hurt you! Break you!
voice_lines.quoidge_pugilist_ancient_attack_02: This'll be over in no time...
voice_lines.quoidge_pugilist_ancient_protect_02: We're not outta the fight yet...
voice_lines.ravenhook_ancient_attack_01: Don't worry, it'll all be over soon.
voice_lines.ravenhook_ancient_both_02: Oh I'm dyin' to see what happens next...
voice_lines.ravenhook_summon_03: Let's get this nasty business over with, shall we?
voice_lines.rebel_decoy_use_ability_03: If I'm lucky I'll survive this.
voice_lines.red_mist_pillager_ancient_attack_02: This is going to be too easy....
voice_lines.red_mist_pillager_ancient_protect_01: There will be more of us in no time...
voice_lines.red_mist_pillager_hero_friend_02: With you leading us, we cannot fail.
voice_lines.red_mist_pillager_summon_02: This is ours for the taking...
voice_lines.revtel_convoy_ancient_attack_02: This business will be over soon.
voice_lines.revtel_convoy_unique_02: You will let us pass or you will die.
voice_lines.riki_if_you_can_see_me: If you can see me, you're already dead.
voice_lines.riki_my_skill_set: My skill set is narrow, but very sharp.
voice_lines.rix_kill_rival_04: We will never bend the knee!
voice_lines.rix_kill_rival_08: I don't fear death. You on the other hand...
voice_lines.roseleaf_rejuvinator_ancient_both_02: This place is under my protection!
voice_lines.roseleaf_rejuvinator_hero_friend_03: Time to deal with these interlopers.
voice_lines.satyr_magician_tower_destroy_02: For my next trick, I'll make your tower disappear.
voice_lines.satyr_magician_tower_destroy_05: You put up a noble fight, but I'm afraid it's over.
voice_lines.satyr_magician_unique_07: How do you still have options?
voice_lines.selfish_cleric_tower_saved_01: I can do this all day.
voice_lines.selfish_cleric_tower_saved_05: I'll fight till my dying breath.
voice_lines.selfish_cleric_unique_07: I know you'll be dead soon, but don't worry I'll be ok.
voice_lines.sis_o_veil_tower_destroy_04: My blade can taste the blood. My lips the victory.
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_angry_08: I will not suffer your arrogance!
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_arrogant_05: One day I'll find someone who is my equal...
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_arrogant_07: Today the Skywrath Mage graces you with his presence...
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_arrogant_09: Weak minds are so easy to deceive...
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_concerned_08: I know I was sent here to die, but I won't go without a fight.
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_concerned_10: If we don't change course soon, we are doomed to fail!
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_pleased_08: Naturally this is going according to plan.
voice_lines.smeevil_blacksmith_ancient_both_01: I will not fail you master.
voice_lines.sniper_arrogant_04: You think a marksman of my skill can be denied?
voice_lines.sniper_enigmatic_05: I have something special in store for you.
voice_lines.sniper_enigmatic_07: Perhaps you're not familiar with what the Keen are capable of.
voice_lines.sorla_khan_arrogant_02: What chance do you have against a Khan of the Red Mist.
voice_lines.sorla_khan_concerned_04: I will meet my death with courage.
voice_lines.sorla_khan_concerned_05: I will not bow to you.
voice_lines.stonehall_elite_ancient_attack_02: In time, only Stonehall will remain.
voice_lines.stonehall_elite_ancient_both_01: This is the moment of truth, isn't it.
voice_lines.stonehall_elite_unique_02: You brought this on your self.
voice_lines.storm_spirit_arrogant_05: At least you entertained me before you died...
voice_lines.storm_spirit_concerned_10: Fear is what makes life worth living...
voice_lines.storm_spirit_enigmatic_08: And in a flash... you're dead.
voice_lines.storm_spirit_enigmatic_09: You and I are going to have some fun, I can tell...
voice_lines.sven_angry_07: You face a knight of the Vigil!
voice_lines.sven_angry_10: You won't live long enough to regret your choices...
voice_lines.sven_arrogant_08: What idiot wishes to lose their life to Sven.
voice_lines.sven_concerned_05: I will not back down, no matter the odds.
voice_lines.sven_concerned_10: This is but a temporary setback....
voice_lines.sven_enigmatic_01: I will live to get revenge...
voice_lines.sven_enigmatic_08: You aren't ready for what I have in store for you...
voice_lines.tidehunter_angry_08: You will drown in a sea of blood...
voice_lines.tidehunter_arrogant_04: I will dominate the land, as I dominate the sea.
voice_lines.tidehunter_enigmatic_06: You don't think you're going to win do you?
voice_lines.timbersaw_arrogant_10: You honestly think you can win, don't you?
voice_lines.timbersaw_enigmatic_01: Oh you won't be laughing for long...
voice_lines.timbersaw_enigmatic_02: I have something special for you...
voice_lines.timbersaw_enigmatic_05: I have a lot of surprises in store for you...
voice_lines.tinker_arrogant_02: I'm the greatest Keenfolk mind in a generation...
voice_lines.tinker_arrogant_04: Congratulations! You provided me with the tools of your own destruction...
voice_lines.tinker_concerned_06: The odds of me surviving seem...poor...
voice_lines.tinker_concerned_10: There's a solution here... I just need to find it...
voice_lines.treant_protector_angry_05: Test your strength against me, and discover your limits.
voice_lines.treant_protector_arrogant_04: A lesser creature like you has no chance against me...
voice_lines.treant_protector_concerned_01: I can't give in to despair.
voice_lines.treant_protector_multi_damage_large_10: The world will go on without you. Emptier, but richer.
voice_lines.troll_soothsayer_ancient_attack_02: I see victory in our future...
voice_lines.troll_soothsayer_ancient_both_02: We are being tested by the gods... we must not fail.
voice_lines.tyler_estate_censor_ancient_attack_01: Your Ancient's power isn't strong enough to save you!
voice_lines.tyler_estate_censor_ancient_both_02: I'll keep this from getting out of hand.
voice_lines.untested_grunt_ancient_both_01: It all comes down to this...
voice_lines.untested_grunt_hero_rival_02: ohhh what have I gotten into...
voice_lines.ursa_angry_02: Angering me was the last mistake you'll make!
voice_lines.ursa_arrogant_02: It's an honor to be killed by my hand.
voice_lines.ursa_arrogant_03: You weren't ready to face me.
voice_lines.ursa_concerned_06: I've brought shame to my people...
voice_lines.ursa_concerned_08: My pride got the better of me...
voice_lines.ursa_enigmatic_08: The river brings us food, drink, and a means to wash off blood.
voice_lines.venomancer_angry_10: Your death will be slow and agonizing...
voice_lines.venomancer_arrogant_02: Within my garden I am sovereign...
voice_lines.venomancer_arrogant_06: It's rather charming that you think you aren't going to die...
voice_lines.venomancer_enigmatic_08: Oh the splendors I will show you...
voice_lines.vhoul_martyr_ancient_both_01: We all must be willing to give everything for our people...
voice_lines.vhoul_martyr_ancient_protect_01: I will not die in vain.
voice_lines.viper_angry_06: I will eat your simmering corpse...
voice_lines.viper_arrogant_01: I can feel your terror from here...
voice_lines.viper_arrogant_08: Have you another army you could call to your aid?
voice_lines.viper_enigmatic_06: I can adapt to any situation...
voice_lines.viper_enigmatic_07: One sorcerer shall bow to me. And then another. And then ten-thousand and more.
voice_lines.winter_wyvern_arrogant_06: I dictate the terms of battle...
voice_lines.winter_wyvern_concerned_07: Maybe I shouldn't have taken them so lightly...
voice_lines.winter_wyvern_enigmatic_03: I should write a book about this...
voice_lines.zeus_arrogant_05: Be glad. Today is the day you get to be murdered by Zeus.
voice_lines.zeus_arrogant_06: It is an honor to be smited by me personally.
voice_lines.zeus_arrogant_10: Ahhh the stupid optimism of mortals...
voice_lines.zeus_concerned_07: Hm, it seems I underestimated you...
voice_lines.zeus_concerned_08: Well you're certainly putting up a fight, aren't you...
voice_lines.zeus_enigmatic_02: I do what I want, when I want...
